title: Engagement Manager SMB
description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. About the role The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the center of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced, strategic Engagement Manager to join our growing team and help a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams fundamentally change the way they work with Legora. This is a role for someone who has developed and executed a scaled customer motion, and who knows that transformation across a large portfolio of clients has to be designed, automated and measured. You will drive adoption, technical health and commercial outcomes of your portfolio end-to-end by leveraging systems and technology while reserving high-touch interactions for the most impactful moments. You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption program at Legora, helping clients realize measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work. What You'll Do: You'll own the post-sale motion end-to-end for a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams across our EMEA scaled portfolio. Specifically, you will: Improve the scaled adoption playbook: the tech-led onboarding, enablement, and change-management motions and target outcomes for how our scale customers adopt Legora and transform the way they work. Execute against that playbook, sequencing automated touchpoints and interventions from initial rollout to firm-wide adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve. Facilitate strategic touchpoints with your highest stakes accounts, while using one-to-many enablement to surface high-impact opportunities and guide the rest of the portfolio toward maximum value from Legora. Drive sustained value through a programmatic operating cadence: templated success plans, one-to-many enablement, scaled training and digital value reviews. Manage the health of the portfolio by monitoring adoption and utilization signals in our internal systems to proactively flag and act on risks and growth opportunities. Own the commercials for the scaled program end-to-end by running renewal and expansion as repeatable motions informed by exquisite portfolio hygiene, forecasting, and data utilization. Orchestrate engagement across cross-functional teams (Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Product Marketing, Support) to accelerate client success, maintaining end-to-end portfolio context and coordination. Translate scaled customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Product Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning, and enablement, and to represent the voice of the scaled segment. What You Bring You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation at scale has to be designed, automated and measured. You're proactive, systems-minded and comfortable making tradeoffs about where to intervene and where to let technology do the work. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed. We’re looking for: A scaled customer success, renewal management, or customer education background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering programs that serve large customer bases. Experience building repeatable adoption playbooks and educational programs and delivering them at scale across digital channels. 3+ years for Manager, 5+ years for Senior Manager, in scaled or digital customer success, customer operations, account management, or a related field, ideally with exposure to high-growth B2B AI verticals or Legal Tech. Leveling will depend on specific experience and fit for the segment. A track record of driving adoption, retention and expansion with a high-volume portfolio of clients. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the role

The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the center of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced, strategic Engagement Manager to join our growing team and help a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams fundamentally change the way they work with Legora.

This is a role for someone who has developed and executed a scaled customer motion, and who knows that transformation across a large portfolio of clients has to be designed, automated and measured. You will drive adoption, technical health and commercial outcomes of your portfolio end-to-end by leveraging systems and technology while reserving high-touch interactions for the most impactful moments.

You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation at scale has to be designed, automated and measured. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed.

  • Experience building repeatable adoption playbooks and educational programs and delivering them at scale across digital channels.

Effiziente Wachstumsstrategie: Konzeption und Implementierung von smarten, budgetschonenden Marketing Maßnahmen, die durch Ideenstärke statt durch hohes Media-Investment überzeugen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung: Direkte Berichtslinie an den COO zur lückenlosen Synchronisation der Marketing-Ziele mit der operativen und kommerziellen Gesamtvision von Zenjob. Du verstehst unsere besondere Zielgruppe und siehst Marke als Kern, der dem Unternehmen eine Ausrichtung gibt und Kunden und Mitarbeiter gleichermaßen begeistert. Langjährige Führungserfahrung: Du bist eine gestandene Leadership-Persönlichkeit, die nachweislich Teams geformt, Strukturen aufgebaut und Mitarbeiter erfolgreich durch Transformationsphasen gecoacht hat. Full-Funnel-Expertise: Tiefgehendes, praxiserprobtes Verständnis für das synergetische Zusammenspiel von Brand, CRM, Performance Marketing und B2B-Marketing. Resilienz und strategischer Weitblick: Ausgewiesene Erfahrung in der strukturellen Aufbauarbeit. Du agierst auch bei der Definition neuer Prozesse mit der nötigen Geduld, Gelassenheit und strategischer Ausdauer. Multidimensionale Perspektive: Du bist mit den Dynamiken des Startup-Sektors vertraut, hast deine Kompetenzen jedoch gleichermaßen in etablierten, strukturell reiferen Unternehmensstrukturen unter Beweis gestellt. Du beherrschst die Balance zwischen Agilität und Corporate-Professionalität. Ressourcenorientierter Ansatz: Du setzt auf die Befähigung interner Talente, smarte Ideen und ein starkes Netzwerk im Unternehmen statt auf externe Dienstleister. raw.description:
About Nucs AI

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity—moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

The Opportunity

Nucs AI is looking for a Machine Learning Scientist to deepen our ML research capabilities in clinical oncology. This is a senior, research-oriented role for someone who wants to develop novel approaches to medical image analysis, treatment outcome prediction, and multi-modal clinical data integration - and see those methods reach real clinical settings.

You’ll work at the intersection of ML research and clinical application, collaborating closely with physicians, medical physicists, and experienced engineers with deep domain expertise. Together, you’ll develop methods that are scientifically rigorous and clinically meaningful. Your work will directly shape our product capabilities and contribute to peer-reviewed science.

What You’ll Do

Research & Method Development

  • Develop novel ML/DL methods for medical image analysis, including segmentation, lesion detection, longitudinal tracking, treatment response prediction, and outcome modeling

  • Design and conduct experiments to evaluate new approaches against clinical baselines and state-of-the-art methods

  • Stay current with the literature and propose research directions that advance Nucs AI’s product and scientific goals

  • Publish findings in top-tier venues (MICCAI, RSNA, JNM, Medical Image Analysis) and represent Nucs AI at scientific conferences

Clinical Translation

  • Collaborate with clinicians and medical physicists to ensure methods are grounded in clinical reality

  • Produce validated research outputs with documented performance benchmarks and clear handoff specifications for production engineering

  • Contribute to clinical validation studies and evidence generation for regulatory submissions

External Engagement

  • Collaborate with external academic research partners on joint studies

  • Support scientific diligence with pharma and clinical partners

  • Contribute to Nucs AI's scientific credibility in the field


What You Bring

  • PhD in machine learning, computer vision, medical image analysis, biomedical engineering, or related field

  • Strong publication record in relevant venues (medical imaging, clinical ML, computer vision)

  • Experience structuring and executing research collaborations with academic and clinical institutions

  • Deep expertise in deep learning architectures for image analysis (CNNs, transformers, U-Nets, etc.)

  • Strong programming skills in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred)

  • Experience working with medical imaging data (PET/CT, MRI, or similar modalities)

  • Strong statistical foundations - experimental design, hypothesis testing, survival analysis, and clinical biostatistics

Bonus Points

  • Experience with nuclear medicine imaging & dosimetry (PSMA-PET, FDG-PET, SPECT)

  • Expertise in treatment outcome prediction, survival analysis, or longitudinal modeling

  • Experience with multi-modal data integration (imaging + clinical + genomic)

  • Familiarity with clinical trial design and regulatory evidence requirements

  • Prior industry experience translating research into deployed products

  • Experience with graph neural networks, molecular representations, or drug-response modeling

  • Experience with Generative AI in medical domain

Why Nucs AI

  • Mission with real impact  – Your work directly improves how cancer patients are diagnosed and treated.

  • Ground-floor opportunity  – Early-stage company, meaningful equity, and outsized influence on the direction we take.

  • World-class collaborators  – Work alongside leading oncologists, nuclear medicine physicians, and AI researchers globally.

  • Massive market tailwinds  – Radioligand therapy and AI-driven oncology are multi-billion dollar growth markets.

  • Autonomy and flexibility  – Remote-first, flexible working. We hire great people and trust them to deliver.

  • Equity upside  – Competitive equity package. We’re building something big and want you to share in it.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a brief note on why this role and Nucs AI excite you.

Equal Opportunity

Nucs AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Partner(m/w/d): Für Interim Manager und Berater: Mandate im Retainer statt Projekte im Tagessatz
company: thexton armstrong Nord und Ost Deutschland
description: Sie arbeiten als Interim Manager oder Berater und kennen die Grenzen des Projektgeschäfts: Jeder Auftrag beginnt mit einer unbezahlten Angebotsphase und endet mit dem Abschlussbericht. Wir bieten Ihnen ein Modell, in dem Mandate über monatliche Retainer laufen, in der Regel über zwölf Monate, mit fünf bis zehn Mandanten parallel, und in dem Sie mit Kollegen in fünf Ländern arbeiten statt allein. Unter der Marke thexton armstrong laden wir erfahrene Berater ein, als geschäftsführende Partner ihre eigene Beratungsgesellschaft in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland aufzubauen. Sie behalten Ihre Unabhängigkeit und gewinnen ein Angebot, das Inhaber sofort verstehen, ein Verfahren für den Einstieg beim Mandanten und eine Marke mit messbaren Ergebnissen. Über thexton armstrong Die Beratungsgesellschaft thexton armstrong ist ein internationales Netzwerk selbständiger Partner, spezialisiert auf die Begleitung von Geschäftsinhabern im Mittelstand und auf Wachstumsberatung. Seit 2012 haben unsere Partner mehreren tausend Geschäftsinhabern geholfen, Ertragskraft, Widerstandsfähigkeit und den langfristigen Wert ihrer Unternehmen zu steigern. Grundlage ist eine strukturierte Methodik, die praktische Führungserfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen verbindet. Wir sind selbst Unternehmer. Jeder Partner führt seine eigene Gesellschaft in einem exklusiven Gebiet und greift zugleich auf die Methodik, die Werkzeuge und das Wissen des gesamten Netzwerks zu. Wir sind in den Niederlanden, Belgien, Süddeutschland, der Schweiz und Großbritannien tätig und bauen jetzt Nord- und Ostdeutschland auf. Aufgaben Ihre Perspektive Regionales Wachstum verantworten: Sie gründen und führen Ihre Beratungsgesellschaft unter der Marke thexton armstrong mit exklusiven Rechte für ein Gebiet in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland. Unternehmen im Mittelstand voranbringen: Sie helfen Unternehmern versickerte Gewinne zu lokalisieren und in ins Unternehmen zurückzuführen. Mithilfe der proprietären thexton armstrong Programme befähigen Sie Unternehmer und Ihre Teams dauerhaft Wachstum, Ergebnis und Unternehmenswert zu steigern und Strukturen zu verbessern. Vom Projektgeschäft zum Mandantenstamm: Ihre Mandanten arbeiten mit Ihnen über monatliche Retainer statt Tagessätze, in der Regel über zwölf Monate und oft über Jahre. Mit fünf bis zehn Mandanten parallel entsteht eine Auslastung, die nicht mit jedem Projektende neu beginnt. Strukturiert akquirieren: Sie gewinnen Mandanten weiterhin selbst, aber mit einem erprobten Einstieg über Discovery-Gespräch und Test zur Gewinnversickerung statt offener Angebotspräsentationen. Dazu bauen Sie ein Empfehlungsnetzwerk aus Steuerberatern, Banken und anderen Partnern auf. Das Gesicht der Marke in Ihrer Region sein: Sie vertreten thexton armstrong gegenüber Unternehmern, Verbänden und Multiplikatoren und gestalten Marketing und Veranstaltungen gemeinsam mit der Regionalorganisation. International zusammenarbeiten: Sie tauschen sich mit Partnern in fünf Ländern über Mandate, Methoden und Erfahrungen aus. Qualifikation Ihr Hintergrund Sie sind seit mehreren Jahren als Interim Manager, Unternehmensberater oder Beirat für mittelständische Unternehmen tätig und haben davor selbst Führungs- und Ergebnisverantwortung getragen. Sie haben mit Inhabern und ihren Führungsteams gearbeitet, nicht nur mit Fachabteilungen in Konzernen. Sie akquirieren selbst und wollen das mit einem strukturierten Verfahren weiter tun. Sie sind bereit, sich auf gemeinsame Standards, eine gemeinsame Marke und ein gemeinsames Reporting einzulassen. Ihre Kompetenzen und Ihre Haltung strategisches und kaufmännisches Urteilsvermögen unternehmerischer Anspruch mit langfristiger Perspektive die Fähigkeit, mit Geschäftsführern und Inhabern Beziehungen aufzubauen und Vertrauen zu gewinnen unabhängig, belastbar, an Ergebnissen orientiert, pragmatisch und authentisch Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (Pflicht), gutes Englisch und Wohnsitz in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland finanziell in der Lage, eine Anlaufphase zu überbrücken und den Ausbau des eigenen Geschäfts zu tragen Benefits Warum mit thexton armstrong? Erprobtes System: mehr als ein Jahrzehnt Erfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen für Mandanten und Partner. Der Erfolg jedes Mandats wird am realisierten Betrag gegenüber dem im Test festgestellten Betrag gemessen. Schlüsselfertiges Geschäftsmodell: Einarbeitung in zehn Workshoptagen über zwei Monate, Methodik, Online-Werkzeuge, Vorlagen und ein Startprogramm für die Mandantengewinnung. Sie entwickeln Ihr Angebot nicht mehr allein weiter. Unterstützung bei der Lead-Generierung: In der Startphase unterstützen wir Sie bei der Gewinnung von Erstkontakten zu Geschäftsinhabern, damit Sie schneller zu ersten Gesprächen kommen und Ihr Mandantenstamm zügiger wächst. Geringe Fixkosten, hohe Autonomie: Sie arbeiten vom Homeoffice oder einem Regionalbüro aus, ohne Personal zu Beginn, und entscheiden selbst über Tempo und Umfang des Ausbaus. Begleitung und Kollegenkreis: laufende Begleitung durch die Regionalverantwortlichen und ein internationales Netzwerk von Partnern mit vergleichbarem Hintergrund. Exklusives Gebiet: Ihr Gebiet ist Ihnen exklusiv zugeordnet; Sie bauen darin Ihren eigenen Mandantenstamm und Ihr eigenes Netzwerk auf. Aktiv akquirieren Sie in Ihrem Gebiet; Mandanten von außerhalb, die von sich aus auf Sie zukommen, dürfen Sie ebenfalls betreuen. Arbeit mit Wirkung: Sie sorgen dafür, dass Geschäftsinhaber ihre Unternehmen ertragsstärker und widerstandsfähiger führen und dabei selbst mehr Freiheit gewinnen. Rahmenbedingungen Sie arbeiten als Unternehmer. Es handelt sich nicht um eine sozialversicherungspflichtige Anstellung. Der Aufbau des Mandantenstamms ist Ihre Aufgabe. Im ersten Jahr steht die Gewinnung von Mandanten im Vordergrund; dafür erhalten Sie ein erprobtes Verfahren, laufende Begleitung und Unterstützung bei der Lead-Generierung. Die Einnahmen bauen sich in dieser Phase auf. Wie bestehende Mandate in der Übergangszeit behandelt werden, besprechen wir im Erstgespräch. Die wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen der Partnerschaft legen wir Ihnen im Erstgespräch vollständig offen. Zusagen zu Einkommen geben wir nicht. Gestalten Sie die Zukunft des Mittelstands in Nord- und Ostdeutschland mit. Dies ist mehr als eine Position: Es ist eine unternehmerische Führungsaufgabe mit Wachstumsperspektive für Berater, die ihre Erfahrung mit einem System und einem Kollegenkreis verbinden und im Mittelstand ihrer Region etwas bewegen wollen. Auswahl und Kontakt Der Weg zu einer Entscheidung führt über ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch (online, 30 bis 45 Minuten), eine Informationsveranstaltung, Gespräche mit bestehenden Partnern und eine Bedenkzeit vor der Unterschrift.Bewerben Sie sich mit Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Motivationsschreiben bei Christian von Volkmann, Managing Partner thexton armstrong Nord- und Ostdeutschland. description: WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures. The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In . We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale. This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. raw.title: Senior Product Designer EMEA
raw.description:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.


TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team

  • Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)

  • Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer

  • Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success


ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are successful if you:

  • Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.

  • Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.

  • Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.

  • Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.

  • Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft.

  • Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles.

  • Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work.

  • Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Product Design

  • Design and prototype user flows, interfaces, and interactions with scalability in mind.

  • Own design problems end to end. From initial concept through execution and iteration after launch.

  • Rapidly produce wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, exploring multiple concepts and iterating quickly.

  • Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable.

  • Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement).

  • Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices.

UX Research & Strategy

  • Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis.

  • Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions.

  • Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on.

  • Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone.

  • Translate research into an informed, evolving UX strategy that guides the roadmap and anchors design direction in real user needs.

  • Advocate for the user in prioritization and roadmap discussions, and define what "better" looks like through clear UX success metrics.

  • Run discovery workshops and share insights so research shows up where decisions are made like in design reviews, product planning, and standups embedding user knowledge from the get-go.

Web & Brand Experience

  • Own the design and evolution of WunderGraph's web presence.

  • Deliver assets that span product and marketing: landing pages, visuals, campaign graphics, and interactive components.

  • Shape and maintain a cohesive style guide, balancing design innovation with consistency.

  • Support brand storytelling with motion graphics and interactive elements.


ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • Senior-level experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work.

  • Proven experience planning and running UX research (both generative and evaluative) and turning findings into strategy.

  • Proficiency in Figma, prototyping tools, and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Strong background in UX and interaction design, accessibility, responsive design, and usability.

  • Experience contributing to or leading design systems and component libraries.

  • Comfortable using data and research to inform and defend design decisions.

  • Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript a plus) enough to collaborate closely with engineers.

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills in English.

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and can lead initiatives independently in a fast-moving startup.

  • Comfortable working 100% remotely in a distributed team.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for team retreats and workshops.






Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

  • You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

  • Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

  • Competitive compensation

  • Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

  • Team retreats across the globe

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position, but we're prioritising candidates from EMEA. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

  • 30 min intro call with Mariya from our People team

  • 45 min discussion with the hiring manager. Following this, you might receive a small take home assignment related to the role. This is your chance to prove your skill!

  • Complete the assignment and review together with hiring manager

  • Meet the founders

  • Culture fit call with team members

  • Offer

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

You can find out more about our ways of working together here:

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources

We’re looking forward to your application so we can grow together!

Sharp written and verbal communication that earns trust with senior leaders, investors, and cross-functional teams. If you don't meet every requirement but have exceptional strengths that could make you excel in this role , we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and let's discuss your potential. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive. Please let us know if you have any specific needs regarding this application process. About us CEEZER is the leading partner for Climate Performance Asset procurement and management, empowering businesses to transform climate ambition into a clear path to net-zero. Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Product und bist erster Ansprechpartner für alle IT-Fragen in unserer Zentrale in Berlin. Du verwaltest unseren Google Workspace: Nutzer, Gruppen, Rechte, Lizenzen und Sicherheitseinstellungen wie die Zwei-Faktor-Anmeldung. Du richtest neue Mitarbeitende mit Konten, Laptops und Handys ein. Beim Austritt entziehst du Zugänge, sicherst Daten und nimmst Geräte zurück. NinjaOne oder vergleichbare Software wie Jamf oder Intune kennst. dich mit macOS, iOS und dem Apple Business Manager auskennst. Grundkenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik hast, idealerweise mit UniFi. Deine Benefits Aufstiegschancen in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Startups Europas. MacBook & Studio Display. Attraktives Gehalt, inklusive 500 € „Close-to-Office"-Bonus. 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss. Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen willst. Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro. This role combines strategic procurement with emerging technologies, offering a high degree of ownership, short decision paths, and direct impact on product development within one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies. What is your Day to Day Mission: Own the sourcing strategy for software, AI, and digital technologies that directly support Quantum Systems' products, platforms, and customer-facing capabilities across the entire product lifecycle. Shape and manage a strategic technology partner ecosystem that accelerates innovation, supports scale-up, and strengthens Quantum Systems’ technology capabilities. Build and evolve a strategic ecosystem for software and digital technologies through driving make-or-buy decisions, supplier selection, contract negotiations, and strategic partnerships that enable innovation, scalability, and business growth. Continuously strengthen the technology ecosystem by identifying innovative partners and solutions while ensuring scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency across the supply base. Contribute as part of a cross-functional team, partnering with Engineering, Product, IT, Cybersecurity, and Legal to provide efficient and cost optimized (license) procurement and advanced value capturing. Manage supplier performance, commercial escalations, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to maintain a high-performing, reliable, and constant competitive technology supply base. title: Data Engineer/ Database Manager (m/w/d), befristet auf 2 Jahre
description: Deine Aufgaben Das ist dein Beitrag: In deiner Rolle als Data Engineer/ Database Manager bist du für den Aufbau, die Betreuung und die Weiterentwicklung moderner Dateninfrastrukturen verantwortlich und gestaltest unsere Datenlandschaft aktiv mit. Du verantwortest die Datenakquise und -integration, z. B. aus bestehenden Kundensystemen sowie über definierte Schnittstellen, und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die dafür erforderlichen Konzepte. In engem Austausch mit deinem Team, den Fachkolleginnen und Fachkollegen sowie unseren Nutzern konzipierst und entwickelst du neue Schnittstellen und sorgst für eine zuverlässige Integration unterschiedlicher Datenquellen. Du gestaltest die konzeptionelle und technologische Weiterentwicklung unserer bestehenden Data-Warehouse- und BI-Systemumgebung mit. Du stellst gemeinsam mit dem Team Datenqualität, Verfügbarkeit und eine effiziente Verarbeitung unserer Daten sicher und entwickelst bestehende Datenprozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Du berätst bei analytischen Fragestellungen auf Grundlage der verfügbaren Daten und arbeitest dabei eng mit unseren Fachbereichen und Kundenteams zusammen. Du wirkst bei der Umsetzung von Anforderungen von der Spezifikation über die Implementierung und das Testing bis zum Rollout mit und übernimmst eigenständig Verantwortung für deine Themen. Du dokumentierst Datenstrukturen, Schnittstellen und Prozesse nachvollziehbar und unterstützt damit einen nachhaltigen Wissenstransfer im Team. Du evaluierst neue Technologien und Lösungsansätze und bringst deine Ideen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Systemlandschaft ein. Im regelmäßigen Austausch mit deinen Teamkolleginnen und -kollegen teilst du dein Wissen und trägst dazu bei, Standards und Best Practices im Database Management weiterzuentwickeln. Dein Profil Das macht dich für uns relevant: Du verfügst über einschlägige praktische Erfahrung im Data Engineering, Database Management, Business Intelligence oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld und möchtest den nächsten Schritt nach einer Junior-Position gehen. Du hast ein Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine entsprechende Ausbildung mit relevanter Berufserfahrung. Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Datenmodellierung und hast praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken. Kenntnisse in PostgreSQL, PL/SQL, PHP und Python sind von Vorteil. Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit ETL-/ELT-Prozessen, Data Warehouses, Schnittstellen und der Integration unterschiedlicher Datenquellen mit. Du besitzt ein gutes technisches Verständnis und kannst gleichzeitig fachliche und betriebswirtschaftliche Anforderungen nachvollziehen und in geeignete Datenlösungen übersetzen. Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert, stimmst dich aber ebenso selbstverständlich mit deinem Team und anderen Fachbereichen ab. Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse und sichere Englischkenntnisse. Du legst für dich persönlich Wert auf: Ownership – Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst Aufgaben proaktiv voran. Lösungsorientierung – Du analysierst Herausforderungen strukturiert und entwickelst pragmatische und nachhaltige Lösungen. Teamwork – Du arbeitest gerne interdisziplinär und teilst dein Wissen aktiv mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Kommunikation – Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln und kommunizierst sicher mit technischen wie auch fachfremden Ansprechpartnern. Motivation – Du begeisterst dich für Daten, Business Intelligence und neue Technologien und hast Freude daran, aus Daten verlässliche Grundlagen für Entscheidungen zu schaffen. Dein Extra Das bieten wir dir: Einen großartigen Teamspirit und spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Zukunftsmarkt und einer Kultur der Verantwortung, Teamworks und Ehrlichkeit. Auch Work from Anywhere kann bei uns möglich gemacht werden. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Home-Office-Tage, kostenlose Getränke, Activity-Raum mit Kicker und anderen Spielen sowie regelmäßige Team-Events. Einsatz aktueller Soft- und Hardware als auch Nutzung innovativer Cloud-Services. Einblick und Arbeit mit vielfältigen Daten aus verschiedenen Phasen des Data Lifecycles. Tatsächliche Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten durch das Einbringen deiner eigenen Ideen und Erfahrungen zur innovativen Weiterentwicklung des DATALOGUE Teams. Eine zentrale Lage und moderne Büros direkt am Gänsemarkt, verkehrsgünstig zu erreichen. Intensive Begleitung und qualifiziertes Feedback im Rahmen des DATALOGUE Entwicklungsprogramms gepaart mit einer offenen Feedbackkultur über alle Ebenen, durch die du gezielt in deiner persönlichen Entwicklung unterstützt wirst. Eine Kooperation mit Urban Sports Club, Jobrad sowie weiteren Partnern zu attraktiven Firmenkonditionen, damit du fit für den Job bleibst. Rahmenbedingungen: Die Position ist auf zwei Jahre befristet. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

As electric vehicles (EVs) are bringing in a transformation of our transport and mobility sectors, AMPECO is at the forefront of a grand revolution and we’re just getting started.

Our product – the AMPECO EV Charging Platform is a business-critical SaaS platform used by companies to manage their electric vehicle charging infrastructure, processes and energy use. It’s already in use by companies in more than 70 countries — across North and South America, Europe, Africa, Asia and Australia.

Our team is highly motivated, capable, and committed to our mission — and our growth is backed by world-class investors, including BMW i Ventures, the mobility-focused venture-capital arm of the BMW Group. We are looking to expand the team with like-minded capable people, eager to give, learn and grow together with us.

About the role

AMPECO is expanding across the DACH region, and we’re looking for a Germany-based Senior Solution Consultant - responsible for pre-sales across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland - to help drive that growth. This is a senior, individual-contributor role for someone who combines deep product and industry expertise with the interpersonal range to win the confidence of technical and business stakeholders alike.

You will be the solutioning counterpart to our DACH Business Development Manager - the two of you working as a close-knit team on the region’s most important opportunities. While the BDM leads the commercial relationship, you own the solution end to end: mapping each prospect’s business needs to AMPECO’s platform, leading demonstrations and Proof-of-Concept engagements, owning bid management for DACH opportunities — from RFx and tenders through to the supporting business case — and making the complex feel clear for everyone in the room.

You won’t be doing this alone. You’ll be enabled by an established Solution Consulting team, with proven tools, practices, and methodologies behind you — so you can put your energy into the deals in front of you. AMPECO already powers some of the most prominent Charge Point Operators in the DACH region and is in active conversations with many of the rest, so you’ll be joining at a moment of real momentum and clear opportunity to expand. As we continue to grow across Germany and the wider region, the impact you make here will be significant — with room to grow alongside it.

If you thrive in fast-paced, complex enterprise environments, enjoy working with highly driven teams, and want to play a pivotal role in the energy transition in one of Europe’s most important EV markets, this role is for you.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of AMPECO’s platform and the e-mobility industry, with a strong grasp of the DACH market and its requirements;

  • Act as the solutioning lead on strategic DACH opportunities, working hand in hand with the DACH Business Development Manager to map each prospect’s business needs to AMPECO’s capabilities;

  • Drive Proof-of-Concept engagements with prospective clients, ensuring the business drivers are sound, relevant, and build a compelling case to advance the opportunity;

  • Design and deliver effective demonstrations that connect AMPECO’s solution advantages to prospects’ business and technical requirements;

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with the key stakeholders involved in DACH deals, becoming a credible advisor throughout the sales cycle;

  • Take an active advisory role during sales cycles, bringing solution expertise and industry best practices to the team;

  • Own bid management for DACH opportunities — taking end-to-end responsibility for RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, and tenders, from structuring and writing the response to coordinating input across teams and managing deadlines;

  • Represent AMPECO at industry events across the region and stay close to market trends, the competitive landscape, and evolving customer needs;

  • Travel across the DACH region as needed for customer engagements, workshops, and events.


    • Your Profile

  • 6+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years in a pre-sales, solution consulting, or similar sales-focused role within enterprise or B2B software;

  • Native-level German and fluent English, both spoken and written — you will work with German-speaking enterprise customers daily;

  • Strong pre-sales execution skills: solution design, demonstrations, Proof-of-Concepts, and bid / RFx management;

  • Tech-savvy and a fast learner on technical topics — comfortable holding technical conversations and explaining how the platform works, without needing to be a deeply technical specialist or engineer;

  • A confident communicator, able to build rapport and credibility with senior business and technical stakeholders and to present complex topics clearly;

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex challenges and shape solutions for evolving business models;

  • Strong business acumen — able to articulate customer value and connect AMPECO’s platform to strategic outcomes;

  • Based in Germany, self-driven and well-organised, and comfortable operating effectively in a remote, distributed team across the DACH region;

  • Naturally curious, with a genuine interest in continuously learning about the product and the industry;

  • A collaborative team player who works seamlessly with Sales, Product, and other specialists;

  • Motivated to build a long-term career in the e-mobility sector.


    • Considered an advantage

  • Domain knowledge in mobility, energy, or a related sector;

  • Familiarity with EV charging technology and standards such as OCPP, OCPI, or ISO 15118;

  • Experience working in a SaaS or PaaS environment with long, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles;

  • Background in consulting or professional services;

  • Experience in enterprise sales;

  • Fluency in an additional European language (e.g. French, Italian).


    • What we offer
  • Competitive salary and benefits package;
  • Flexibility to work from anywhere in Germany or from a modern co-working space in Munich's Werksviertel, near Ostbahnhof;
  • Opportunity to grow with a mission-driven startup in a high-impact industry.
    • Our team at AMPECO is deeply committed to our mission and we're looking for like-minded individuals eager to give, learn and grow with us. If you're passionate about innovative technology and want to make a real impact in the e-mobility sector, we want to hear from you. Join AMPECO in building the future of EV charging!
     
    Our interview process is entirely remote. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Spinning Disk Confocal Specialist – Advanced Life Science Systems, Central Europe
description: Your responsibilities The Spinning Disk Confocal Specialist role requires that you work closely together with the European Life Science Sales Teams (Territory Managers and Senior Sales Specialists). You are responsible for supporting the direct sales team and distributors in driving the sales process for our spinning disk confocal systems, alongside other high-end life science microscopy systems, in your territory (primarily Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Eastern Central Europe), covering both direct and indirect sales. During the sales process you will have meetings with customers to present our product portfolio, and you will organize and perform in a convincing way onsite system demonstrations as well as remote demonstrations, providing your expert knowledge to solve customers’ applications and issues. The product portfolio mainly consists of confocal laser scanning microscopes, spinning disk and TIRF microscopes, slide scanners and SMLM systems. You are responsible for achieving the agreed sales target for your products and territory as well as a team target. As a Spinning Disk Confocal Specialist for Advanced Life Science Systems, you are - together with Sales Management - responsible for observing market trends and proposing and developing strategic sales activities to further develop our business and success in the market. Due to the territory, you will be responsible for, you ideally live in Germany or Austria, with good connection possibilities to highways, train stations and airports. Class B driver's license is mandatory. Home Office based worker. The following activities – among others – will help you to achieve your goals: Supporting the direct sales team and distribution partners in driving the sales process for our spinning disk confocal solutions in your territory. Supporting and developing distribution partners in your territory, including joint customer visits, demonstrations and product training. Enabling distribution partners to position our systems competitively, and holding regular joint pipeline reviews with them and the direct sales team. Managing, organizing and conducting all customer touch points during the sales process (incl. for example customer meetings, system demonstrations, workshops, closing meetings etc.). You will be travelling approximately 60% of your time, primarily within your territory. Cooperating in a very close way with senior sales specialists and other sales and application specialists in Europe, especially for your demo and workshop activities. Providing help to colleagues outside your territory, including opportunities across EMEA, depending on your expertise and business needs. Conducting lectures and training at customer events. Participating in local exhibitions. Observing and analyzing the market and deducting an action plan for your territory with the goal to increase market share. Positioning our systems against competing platforms in customer evaluations and head-to-head demonstrations, with the aim of winning competitive opportunities. Tracking competitor products, pricing and customer wins and losses, and feeding these insights back to Sales Management, Marketing and Product Management. Gather best-practice cases and actively share experiences and knowledge within the Advanced Life Science Systems sales team. Supporting the Marketing team and Sales Management in collecting testimonials, image materials, application notes, etc. from your customers, and using them as proof points to show where our systems outperform the competition. Your qualification University degree in Biology, Chemistry, Biotechnology /Engineering or similar is an advantage. A higher degree (e.g. PhD) or a background in scientific research using spinning disk confocal or comparable imaging technologies is also highly valued. Minimum of 3–5 years’ professional experience in a specialist role using spinning disk confocal technology, either in a core facility supporting multiple users or in a field sales or applications role. Several years of experience in operating and/or selling complex, software-controlled microscope systems; experience in systems integration is an advantage. Excellent technical understanding of optics, optical instruments and applications, with hands-on experience of multimodal imaging technologies (e.g. Spinning Disk Confocal Imaging, TIRF, FRAP, Photoactivation, Superresolution). Good understanding of biological applications in the high-end spinning disk confocal imaging field, with a broader knowledge of confocal microscopy, super-resolution microscopy and live cell imaging. Established network in the confocal microscopy community, including credibility with core facility managers and key opinion leaders who influence purchasing decisions Ability to support both direct and indirect sales channels, including training and enabling distribution partners to position our systems competitively. Capable of identifying and understanding market trends and demands and transferring them into operational sales activities. Working knowledge of competing spinning disk and confocal platforms, and the ability to position our systems against them on technical and application grounds. Deep appreciation of how competitive evaluations are won, gained either through a track record of winning them in a sales or applications role (e.g. head-to-head demonstrations and benchmark studies), or through direct involvement in them as an influencer or decision-maker in an instrument purchase, for example in a core facility. Understanding of research funding and public tender processes in the DACH region, and the ability to influence specifications and evaluation criteria at an early stage. Fluent German and English (spoken and written); additional languages are an advantage Benefits 30 days of holiday per year 13,5 salaries a year Modern office and inspiring working environment Employee Assistance Program to support your health, mental and emotional well-being Comprehensive company pension scheme Joint company events and activities Evident Europe GmbH is an equal opportunities employer and we look forward to receiving your application. description: KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business. As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. Every machine learning model KAYAK ships depends on reliable, scalable infrastructure to move from experiment to production — and that's exactly what this role makes possible. KAYAK is seeking a Senior MLOps Engineer who will focus on the design and implementation of our machine learning infrastructure and production lifecycle. This is a senior, hands-on role where you will bridge the gap between data science and production engineering. You will join the Machine Learning Platform team and be responsible for building and maintaining scalable infrastructure & automated pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring, ensuring our ML models are reliable, reproducible, and performant. You will work closely with Data Scientists, ML Engineering and Operations teams to transform experimental code into robust, production-ready services at scale. This role requires commuting to the Berlin office 3 times a week. In this role, you will: Build and maintain ML infrastructure end-to-end: Extend and operate the infrastructure that powers every model we ship — including CI/CD pipelines, model orchestration, and automated training pipelines designed to scale reliably without manual intervention. Own model deployment and serving: Help define and evolve the standards and tooling for model serving, ensuring low latency and high availability across our ML services. Develop core MLOps capabilities: Establish and maintain essential infrastructure that functions as reliable, self-service systems for the entire machine learning organization — with a focus on feature stores, model registries, and automated monitoring for performance and data drift. Operationalize infrastructure for the ML team: Collaborate with Operations to enable Kubernetes (k8s) autoscaling and GPU provisioning, turning these into accessible, self-service tools for ML practitioners — including standing up and operating a Kubernetes-based development cluster and taking models from experimentation to GPU-backed production. Improve platform reliability and performance: Partner with Operations to design resilient monitoring using advanced observability tooling. Define service-level objectives and implement automation to reduce manual interventions and improve system reliability. Empower Data Scientists through standardized, optimized workflows: Amplify the impact of the ML team by building clear, well-supported "golden paths" — standardized workflows that streamline the model development lifecycle and let Data Scientists focus on modeling while you handle the infrastructure. Please apply if you have: Experience building and operating ML platforms in production environments. Solid working knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), Linux internals, and model serving at scale. Familiarity with ML lifecycle tooling, including orchestration frameworks, feature stores, model registries, and drift or performance monitoring. Experience owning production systems: defining service-level objectives (SLOs), building observability (for example, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog), participating in incident response, and diagnosing large-scale failures systematically. You look for opportunities to automate repetitive work rather than absorb it. Comfort writing production-quality code in Python or a comparable language. Experience modernizing production infrastructure with attention to reliability, risk, and cost — including thoughtful sequencing of work to maintain availability and continuity for live systems. The ability to take ownership of technical outcomes, advocate for decisions using data, and communicate clearly in writing and in person — to both technical and non-technical audiences. Your Role

We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Product Designer to join our growing design team and help shape the future of AI companionship.

You’ll work across multiple product surfaces, including conversational experiences, character creation, monetization flows, growth experiences, interactive features, and emerging product areas still being defined.

You’ll work closely with our Product Design Lead, Product Managers, and Engineers to solve complex product problems, explore new opportunities, and help define the next generation of consumer AI experiences.

We’re looking for someone with strong product judgment, technical fluency, excellent communication, and the ability to contribute original ideas that raise the bar.

Your Responsibilities

Product Design

  • Own end-to-end design across multiple product areas from concept through delivery

  • Translate complex product and technical challenges into intuitive, high-quality user experiences

  • Balance speed, experimentation, and craft across fast-moving initiatives

  • Design for engagement, retention, monetisation, and conversion at scale

  • Create and iterate on visual content (image + video) to support product exploration, in-product experiences, and marketing/growth surfaces

Product Thinking & Innovation

  • Contribute original product ideas and creative concepts

  • Identify opportunities beyond the immediate brief

  • Help shape new features and interaction patterns through proactive exploration

  • Push ideas further through experimentation and thoughtful challenge

We value designers who don’t just execute; we want people who actively contribute ideas that surprise, inspire, and unlock new opportunities.

Technical & Workflow Fluency

  • Work confidently across modern design, prototyping, and creative tooling

  • Experiment with new workflows that improve speed and output quality

  • Operate comfortably close to engineering constraints and implementation realities

  • Use emerging tools thoughtfully to accelerate exploration and execution

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Communicate design reasoning clearly and confidently

  • Push back when needed

  • Collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and Leadership

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • Strong experience designing high-quality consumer digital products

  • Excellent product thinking and interaction design

  • Strong technical fluency and comfort working with AI tools

  • Strong prototyping skills — able to choose the right approach and fidelity (e.g., design tools vs. code-based prototypes) based on the question being tested

  • High design taste and strong visual judgment

  • Confidence operating independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)

⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

title: Senior ATE Test Engineer (f/m/d)
description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects About our technology The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution The Role As a Senior Automated Test Equipment (ATE) Test Engineer, you will own the bring-up and operation of our high-volume 300 mm wafer test infrastructure for electronic-photonic integrated circuits. On a daily basis, you will set up and qualify ATE test cells, develop and debug test programs for DC, RF, and electro-optical device characterization, and drive probe card design with vendors. You will analyze wafer-level data to make pass/fail calls and share insights with design and process teams, helping us scale from engineering characterization to high-volume production. To join our team, you should be excited to: Set up, qualify, and calibrate ATE test cells, ensuring readiness for high-volume wafer testing. Develop and debug automated test programs for DC, RF, optical, and electro-optical device characterization, including new measurement methods. Own probe card specifications, design, qualification, and integration, alongside associated interface hardware, in collaboration with vendors. Collaborate across teams to define comprehensive measurement plans and contribute to design-for-test (DFT) implementation. Collect, analyze, and report wafer-level measurement data to determine pass/fail outcomes and support yield monitoring, reliability testing, and failure analysis. Transfer laboratory characterization methods into production, developing automated test protocols and equipment specifications for manufacturing integration. Optimize test throughput while maintaining measurement accuracy and reliability. Work with manufacturing engineering to implement statistical process control (SPC), improve yield, and strengthen test efficiency and data analytics. Support supplier qualification, vendor evaluation, and incoming material characterization. Create test documentation and training materials, ensuring procedures meet industry standards and customer quality requirements. Your Qualifications Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline. At least five years of hands-on experience setting up and operating ATE systems, including wafer probers and probe card specification, qualification, and integration. Strong programming skills in Java and Python for test automation, instrument control, and automated data collection. Hands-on experience performing electrical, optical, and electro-optical measurements on EIC and PIC devices; RF or high-speed testing experience is a plus. A sound understanding of PIC and/or EIC device structures and operation, including EIC-to-PIC interface architectures. Practical knowledge of design-for-test (DFT) methodologies and their implementation in integrated circuits. A proven track record of transferring laboratory test methods and device characterization into production environments. Proficiency in data processing, statistical analysis, and visualization using Python, Java, or LabVIEW, with experience applying statistical process control (SPC) and monitoring yield, process performance, and reliability. Knowledge of supplier management, incoming material characterization, and vendor qualification processes. Experience in a fast-paced startup or semiconductor manufacturing environment is preferred. Advanced knowledge of optoelectronic device physics, graphene-based devices, and semiconductor operating principles is an advantage. Familiarity with photonic component qualification methodologies and industry reliability testing standards is a plus. Experience characterizing and testing optoelectronic or semiconductor packaging is an advantage. Our work culture People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect! Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow.  

At Unzer, we are driven by the belief that customers should enjoy a seamless shopping experience, no matter where they choose to shop. We are a team of over 750 experts from 50+ different nationalities, dedicated to creating a state-of-the-art unified commerce platform. Our goal is to enable businesses to delight their customers with a seamless payment experience.  

Whether you're a tech enthusiast, a payment expert, or a dedicated support professional, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a difference.  

Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany, and Luxembourg with a HQ in Berlin.  

ABOUT THE TEAM

At Unzer, the Data Protection Team is part of the Legal Department and plays a key role in enabling our business to grow responsibly in a highly regulated environment. We partner closely with teams across the organization to ensure that privacy and data protection requirements are embedded into products, processes, and innovation initiatives from the start. 

Following Unzer's merchant-first principle, we take a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach to data protection, balancing regulatory compliance with business needs. As part of our team, you will work at the intersection of law, technology, and innovation. 


What your work will look like:

  • Drive data protection compliance across the business and act as a trusted advisor on privacy-related matters. 

  • Partner with stakeholders across the organization to ensure privacy requirements are embedded into new products, services, and business initiatives. 

  • Conduct data mapping activities, DPIAs, and TIAs, translating regulatory requirements into practical and scalable solutions. 

  • Manage key processes and documentation, including records of processing activities, privacy notices, policies, and procedures. 

  • Draft, review, and negotiate data protection agreements, and support the handling of data subject rights requests. 

  • Coordinate the assessment and resolution of data protection incidents, including remediation measures and regulatory reporting where required. 

  • Collaborate with the Data Protection Officer and bring your privacy expertise to AI and innovation initiatives, including compliance with the EU AI Act. 


What you need to be successful in this role:

  • Preferably a full legal qualification (1st and 2nd State Exam), a degree in Law, IT, Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification are also welcome, ideally complemented by data protection training or certification. 

  • 2-5 years of hands-on experience in data protection, privacy, or a related compliance role. 

  • Strong knowledge of GDPR and German data protection law, with a practical understanding of international data transfer requirements. 

  • Experience managing key privacy processes, such as DPIAs, TIAs, data protection agreements, data subject requests, and privacy incidents. 

  • A proactive and pragmatic mindset, combined with strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills. 

  • An interest in technology, AI, and emerging regulatory developments. Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated industry is an advantage. 

  • Professional fluency in English and German, both written and spoken. 


What's next?

Does it sound exciting? -  Apply with your CV in English or German. Please don’t shy away if you don’t meet all the requirements! We’re looking forward to meeting you.  

We will get back to you within 14 days of receiving your application.   

The interview process includes: a 30min intro call with a TA Partner, a 45min conversation with your potential manager and an approx. 45min Team interview. Please note the process might alter depending on our team’s availability.

WHAT WE OFFER 

More than a workplace. A place to grow. 🌍 

At Unzer, colleagues from 50+ nationalities across four countries work together to create better outcomes for our merchants. We take ownership, move with pace and keep raising the bar—as one team. 

We set high expectations and give you the flexibility, learning opportunities and practical support to do your best work, grow your impact, and build a sustainable career. 

🏡 Flexibility that works 
Combine focused time at home with connection and collaboration in the office. Our hybrid setup includes two office days per week. 

🚲 Your commute, your choice 
Choose the mobility benefit that works for you: bike leasing or a Deutschlandticket.  

🏖️ Work from anywhere in the EU 
Change your perspective and work from another EU country for up to 15 days per year. 

📗 Keep raising the bar 
Use an annual learning budget of €1,000 for courses, conferences, certifications and other development opportunities that help you grow and increase your impact.  

🫴 Support when you need it 
Access confidential counselling whenever you need support with personal or professional matters. 

💰 Build your future 
Look ahead with our company pension scheme and take care of your long-term financial wellbeing. 

 

Benefits may vary by location and employment setup. Your recruiter will share the details relevant to your role.

raw.title: Founding Brand Manager (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Seit unserem Launch ermöglichen wir EV-Besitzern einen schnellen & reibungslosen Verkauf innerhalb von 48h. Kaufende Händler aus ganz Europa haben Zugriff auf E-Autos von bisher nicht erschlossene Kundengruppen.

Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Sixt, Porsche, Mercedes, Enterprise und Cazoo.


Deine Mission

Wir bauen bei Aampere gerade eine Marke von 0 auf. Bisher kommen über 95 % unserer Kunden aus Growth Marketing und unsere Brand Awareness bei EV-Fahrern liegt bei ca. 5 bis 10 %.
Da wir eine starke B2C-Brand aufbauen wollen, wissen wir, dass wir früh in Brand investieren müssen. Wer in Deutschland ein E-Auto verkaufen will, soll automatisch an Aampere denken und wir suchen die Person, die das für uns umsetzt.
Die Strategie legst du mit dem Head of Marketing fest. Die Umsetzung liegt komplett bei dir, ohne Micro-Management im Tagesgeschäft.

Du planst die Kampagnen und führst sie auch durch. Du entscheidest Umfang, Region, Kanäle und Botschaft, von OOH über YouTube bis PR und Community. Nichts ist vorentschieden. Du testest Regionen gegeneinander und skalierst, was gewinnt.
Du bestimmst, wofür Aampere steht. Aus Research zu Kunden, Markt und Wettbewerb entstehen Positionierung, Narrative und Tone of Voice. Das Fundament gibt es noch nicht, aber die Research dafür würde schon gestartet.
Du denkst über Awareness Kanäle hinaus. Ein großer Teil unserer Brand Wahrnehmung entsteht während des Sales Prozesses. Du denkst vom ersten bis zum letzten Touchpoint der Customer Journey und sorgst in den richtigen Momenten für die richtige Message & Erfahrung.
Du bekommst ein sechsstelliges Budget. Wir planen ein festes Budget für Brand in 2027 ein. Wohin wir es investieren, liegt komplett bei dir.


Das bringst du mit

Du hast eine Brand von null mitgebaut. 4 bis 6 Jahre Brand-Erfahrung im B2C, Startup oder startup-nah. Du hast nicht ein bereits bestehendes System verwaltet, sondern eines aufgebaut.
Du denkst von Konzept bis Go-Live. Du hast Multi-Channel-Kampagnen bereits selbst konzipiert und live gebracht. Du weißt genau, wann welcher Kanal der richtige ist und wie wir unsere Message gezielt an die Kunden übermitteln. Du musst dabei nicht jeden Schritt selbst ausführen, sondern kannst auch auf externe Ressourcen zurückgreifen.
Du hast kreative Ideen und verstehst, weshalb sie funktionieren. Wir suchen die Person, die auf Sachen kommt, an die im Growth-Team niemand denkt. Zeig uns eine Kampagne, die es ohne dich nicht gegeben hätte und was danach messbar anders war.
Du baust das Fundament, nicht nur die Maßnahmen. Gute Kampagnen entstehen nur durch eine gute Grundlage. Du weißt, wie man aus Research eine Brand-Identity baut und kannst sie genau erklären.
Du bist ein Operator. Du führst eigenständig Audits, Feldbefragungen und Kampagnen durch. Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen und brauchst niemanden, der dich steuert.
Du denkst in Ergebnissen. Uns ist bewusst, dass Brand nicht 100% messbar ist. Trotzdem erwarten wir Outcome-getriebenes Handeln. Du findest heraus, wie wir eine starke, wiedererkennbare Marke bauen und erst Deutschland und anschließend EU-weit distribuieren.
Du bist AI-native. Eigene, kreative Ideen sind uns extrem wichtig. Für die Umsetzung solltest du allerdings AI allerdings als Hebel nutzen können, um Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen.
Deutsch ist deine Muttersprache. Unser B2C-Messaging findet zunächst in Deutschland statt. Gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.


Why Aampere?

Startup Umfeld: jeden Tag etwas bewirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Welt elektrisieren
Persönliches Wachstum: Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen
Tech: Ob Apple oder Windows, dein Laptop wird von uns gestellt. Du entscheidest, womit du am besten arbeitest.
Urban Sports Club und 58€ Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what’s next?
Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im naheliegenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten - mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. 


Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. Deshalb bist du mindestens vier Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office.

...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.

...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren.

...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt.

...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen.


Wie wir arbeiten

Drei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten, einstellen und wachsen:

Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun.
Aambition to grow. Wir wollen wachsen, als Menschen und als Unternehmen.
Aampact over Hierarchy. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion.


Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss

Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung - alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam.

Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist. Wir fördern eine Kultur des Respekts und Miteinanders, in der jede Stimme gehört wird, persönliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist und Wertschätzung an erster Stelle steht.

relevant to façade and external wall performance.</li> <li>Assist senior engineers with coordination between internal disciplines and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Attend site visits, design meetings, and client meetings as required, under supervision.</li> <li>Maintain accurate records, site notes, and project documentation in accordance with internal procedures.</li> <li>Actively participate in training, mentoring, and professional development activities.</li> <li>Work in accordance with Jensen Hughes quality, safety, and governance procedures at all times.</li> </ul> <p>During the first 12–24 months, we expect successful candidates to grow into the role by developing the following skills and competencies:</p> <ul> <li>Develop a sound understanding of façade systems, materials, and construction methods.</li> <li>Build familiarity with external wall fire safety principles, relevant legislation, and guidance.</li> <li>Gain practical site experience through
