as applied to façade systems.</li> <li>Demonstrate increasing independence in technical tasks under supervision.</li> <li>Progress towards professional accreditation and longer-term chartership pathways.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements and Qualifications</strong></p> <p>To set you up for success in the role, you’ll need:</p> <ul> <li>Right to work in the UK or Ireland.</li> <li>A Master’s degree, achieved within the last two years or expected, in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering, or Physics.</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The following would also help you succeed in the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A second European language is an advantage but not essential.</li> <li>Interest in façade engineering, external walls, and fire safety.</li> <li>Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings and specifications.</li> <li>Interest in thermal and/or structural aspects of façade performance.</li> <li>Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.</li> <li>Collaborative approach and willingness to work as part of a multidisciplinary team.</li> </ul> <p>We’ve successfully welcomed Graduate Facade Engineers from a&nbsp;variety of STEM Master’s backgrounds, including Mechanical Engineering,&nbsp;Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering and Physics. Many of these individuals have&nbsp;gone on to build outstanding careers with us.</p> <p>If you’re committed to pursuing a career in Facade Engineering&nbsp;and have a transferable STEM Master’s degree, we’d love to hear from you. Tell&nbsp;us why you’re ready to start your career with Jensen Hughes.</p> <p><strong>Graduate Development Programme</strong></p> <p>Starting your career is about more than your first role,&nbsp;it’s about building the foundations for your future.</p> <p>Our Graduate Development Programme gives you hands-on&nbsp;project experience, mentorship and support as you work towards professional&nbsp;accreditation. Over two years, you’ll gain experience across fire engineering&nbsp;and related disciplines, helping you build the knowledge and skills needed for&nbsp;a successful and impactful career.</p> <p>You’ll also have the opportunity to undertake <strong>Continuing Professional Development (CPD)</strong> as you progress through the programme, helping you continue to develop your technical knowledge and professional skills. We provide support and encouragement for Engineers working towards <strong>Chartered Engineer status</strong>, helping you work towards this important professional milestone as you build your career with Jensen Hughes.</p> <p><strong>Sustainability in Fire Engineering</strong></p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, fire safety and sustainability go hand in&nbsp;hand.</p> <p>In the UK, we support the design of safe, energy-efficient&nbsp;and sustainable buildings that meet BREEAM standards and align with net-zero&nbsp;goals. As a graduate, you’ll play a role in delivering solutions that protect&nbsp;people while helping to create a more sustainable built environment.</p> <p><strong>Our People Are Our Greatest Asset</strong></p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we know that our people are the foundation&nbsp;of our success. To attract and retain the best talent, we offer a competitive&nbsp;and comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing,&nbsp;work-life balance, and professional growth.</p> <p><strong>Our UK&amp;I Benefits Include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Private medical insurance</li> <li>33 days of holiday(including<br>bank holidays) with an additional day after 3 years</li> <li>Industry-leading contributory pension scheme</li> <li>4x life assurance</li> <li>Income protection scheme</li> <li>Discretionary bonus scheme</li> <li>Employee assistance programme</li> <li>Enhanced parental-related pay</li> <li>Recognition and reward programmers to celebrate<br>team efforts</li> <li>Access to extensive technical training and<br>resources</li> </ul> <p><strong>Supporting Your Work-Life Balance:</strong></p> <p>We understand the importance of flexibility and balance.&nbsp;We're happy to discuss hybrid, part-time, and flexible working arrangements to&nbsp;suit both you and the business. We regularly review our benefits programme to ensure it aligns with statutory requirements, market trends, and the needs of our team. Any modifications will be carefully considered to support our employees and the company’s long-term goals.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-JC1</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>Jensen Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.</strong></em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate.&nbsp; We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process.&nbsp; Please click <strong><a href="https://www.jensenhughes.com/careers/responsible-use-of-ai-in-the-jensen-hughes-recruitment-process">here</a></strong> to review.</p> <p><br>The security of your personal data is important to us. description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>About WPP Production</strong></p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing">We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite&nbsp;cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel&nbsp;in a single company –&nbsp;powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open,&nbsp;to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit&nbsp;<a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__http://wpp.com/__;!!JboVxjCXSME!N9KGoZIn5nCC-uOWhEdE-ChrrJuf6TgkLzNNkLaW9BExJsVqZZ_hMSmGbARJ0tdBOnKYM7kEbv5L3ncUpg7-6uEPNdY$" data-outlook-id="6ded86b6-cde3-4e48-958d-34727f881edd">WPP.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>A Hybrid working model</strong></p> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <p class="xmsonormal"><em>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</em></p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>What does a Global Hub Operations Director do at WPP Production?</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>Lead the operational performance and development of Studio A’s global production hub network. The role sets a consistent operating standard across locations, turns demand into credible capacity plans, and ensures hubs can deliver secure, high quality work at the service levels and economics agreed with the client. It connects Hub Operations Leads, delivery and capability leaders, Geo teams, Commercial, Talent, HR, Finance, Technology and Facilities so that decisions on capacity, location, cost and risk are made with one view of the facts.</p> <p>The Director leads through the Hub Operations Leads and the global operating cadence. They own the hub operating model and its execution, while partnering with the relevant functional and commercial owners on decisions outside hub operations.</p> <p><strong>Reporting&nbsp;lines and&nbsp;key stakeholders:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Reports to the Global Operations Director. Manages and develops the Hub Operations Leads across the global network, with clear local accountabilities and escalation routes.</li> <li>Covers centralised production hubs and the resources, infrastructure, controls and services required to support Worldwide and Geo demand, including permanent and flexible capacity.</li> <li>Works in a matrix with Heads of Delivery, capability SMEs, Geo and client operations, Commercial, Talent, HR, Finance, Security, Technology and Facilities. Local employment, technical craft and client commercial approval remain with their designated owners.</li> </ul> <h4>Key Responsibilities:</h4> <h4>Global hub strategy and governance</h4> <ul> <li>Set the hub operating model, decision rights and governance for shared capacity, including how Worldwide and Geo demand is prioritised, allocated and escalated when requirements conflict.</li> <li>Maintain a practical Hub Playbook covering planning, onboarding, access and security, local compliance, service management, financial controls, business continuity and location specific requirements. Audit adoption and close gaps.</li> <li>Assess the hub footprint against demand, capability, resilience, cost, security and talent availability. Develop business cases and transition plans for expansion, consolidation or changes in the mix of work across locations.</li> <li>Run a regular hub leadership cadence, with consistent status reporting, decisions, actions and cross hub learning. Chair operational reviews and escalate material trade offs promptly.</li> </ul> <h4>Capacity, workforce and delivery</h4> <ul> <li>Translate demand forecasts, Workshop peaks and capability plans into a rolling view of capacity by hub, skill, language, security classification and employment type. Test scenarios for changes in volume, complexity, timing and location.</li> <li>Work with Delivery, SMEs and Geo leaders to allocate shared resources, manage utilisation and productivity, protect service levels and balance work across hubs. Identify bottlenecks early and agree actions rather than relying on local workarounds.</li> <li>Set requirements for permanent and flexible staffing with Talent and HR; oversee readiness, onboarding, training and exit planning for large scale programmes and demand changes. Ensure employment classification and local legal or tax questions go to the accountable specialists.</li> <li>Lead operational readiness for Workshops and other surges, including space, technology, security, access, staffing, shifts, supplier support and contingency capacity.</li> <li>Own the operational response to a hub disruption. Keep tested continuity and recovery plans, including transfer options, cross training, access dependencies and client approvals where required.</li> </ul> <h4>Commercial performance and controls</h4> <ul> <li>Provide the operational data and discipline needed to run the commercial model as agreed: retained capacity, complexity based deliverables and approved time and materials exceptions. Ensure work is coded and measured consistently so actual demand, effort and cost can be compared with the model.</li> <li>Partner with Commercial and Finance on forecast accuracy, capacity pool economics, the minimum spend commitment, margin, scope changes, rush requests and Workshop demand. Identify the operational causes of variance and propose corrective actions; do not change prices or commitments without the agreed approval route.</li> <li>Supply a reliable monthly operational pack covering volumes and complexity, capacity and utilisation, forecast accuracy, service levels, quality, revisions and exceptions. Support quarterly commercial reviews of spend, margin, demand, savings and capacity risks, and the annual review of unit prices, cost adjustment, efficiency commitment and baseline capacity.</li> <li>Drive measurable productivity and the contracted efficiency commitment through improved planning, workflow, automation and location mix while protecting quality, security and sustainable capacity. Validate savings with Finance and avoid double counting.</li> <li>Ensure hub financial procedures, hiring controls, approved rates, procurement and contractor processes are followed. Surface non compliant practices and remediate them with the accountable teams.</li> </ul> <h4>Systems, data and improvement</h4> <ul> <li>Define the operational requirements and adoption plan for the resource management platform, including estimates, staffing plans, scenario planning, schedules, timesheets, PTO and overtime, capacity reporting and relevant integrations.</li> <li>Set data definitions, ownership and quality controls across hubs so leadership can trust capacity, productivity, delivery and cost reporting. Use the data to diagnose recurring constraints and measure whether interventions work.</li> <li>Partner with Technology and process owners on rollout of production tools, language capacity planning, freelancer management and workflow improvements. Ensure local teams are trained and changes are embedded.</li> </ul> <h4>People, partnerships and risk</h4> <ul> <li>Lead, coach and assess Hub Operations Leads. Build an integrated leadership team with clear expectations, succession cover and consistent management standards across locations.</li> <li>Build trusted relationships with senior Delivery, Geo, capability and client operations stakeholders. Make trade offs visible, resolve competing priorities and communicate decisions with clarity.</li> <li>Oversee hub risks relating to security, confidentiality, health and safety, infrastructure, service continuity and local compliance. Maintain a visible risk and action log, with owners and deadlines, and escalate issues that need executive decisions.</li> </ul> <h4>Measures of success</h4> <ul> <li>Reliable delivery against agreed service levels, quality and security requirements across the hub network.</li> <li>Capacity and forecast accuracy by pool, with healthy utilisation, controlled overtime and a clear response to peaks and gaps.</li> <li>Commercial performance supported by trusted operational data, early variance management and validated efficiency gains.</li> <li>Consistent controls and operating standards, evidenced through reviews, audit actions and business continuity readiness.</li> <li>Effective Hub Operations Leads, clear stakeholder confidence and decisions made at the right level.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Senior operations leadership in a complex, multi location production, agency, shared services or comparable environment, including management through local leaders and matrix teams.</li> <li>Strong command of capacity planning, workforce mix, service performance, financial controls and commercially consequential operational decisions.</li> <li>Ability to turn incomplete demand and cost data into practical scenarios, recommendations and executive decisions. Confident with metrics and able to challenge assumptions.</li> <li>Experience of scaling or reshaping hub operations, leading change in systems and processes, and managing security and continuity requirements.</li> <li>Direct, collaborative leadership; sound judgement under pressure; strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions; concise written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-LS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Why work here:&nbsp;<br></strong><span data-teams="true">At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment. </span></p> <p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Inclusion and Impact&nbsp;</strong><br>WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. <br><strong><br></strong><strong>Data</strong><br>We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy&nbsp;<span style="text-decoration: underline;"><a href="https://www.hogarthww.com/privacy-policy">st</a><a href="https://www.hogarth.com/privacy-policy">atement</a>.</span> This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.<br><br></p> <div> <div> <p class="xmsonormal" style="text-align: left;"><strong>Please contact <a ----- ----- if you need the job advert or form in another format.</strong></p> </div> </div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Every mind is unique. Yet much of the world is still built for what’s considered "normal," leaving too many people behind. At Everway, we change that by creating technology that helps everyone understand and be understood. By understanding and addressing the unique needs of each individual, we're creating a world where differences are recognized and valued.</p> <p>Our careers fit real life. Delivering a great platform means product engineers can ship quality, scalable solutions; product, design, and non-technical colleagues can prototype ideas quickly using our application code and production data as a baseline; shoppers have responsive, personalised in-store experiences; and retailers and brands can configure, monitor, and analyse their campaigns across potentially billions of data points.

We're agentic-first. Every engineer has access to frontier AI tooling and our own coding harness, and we expect you to use them to move faster, attempt more ambitious work, and stay fully accountable for what you ship.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, though Staff engineers and ambitious early-career engineers with strong platform instincts will also be considered.

What You'll Own

  • Product security. Own authentication across algo1, retailer and brand employees, shoppers, devices, agents, and third-party services, alongside authorisation covering RBAC and ReBAC.

  • Release engineering. Develop and maintain reliable, consistent automated release cycles that get changes to production safely and quickly.

  • Cloud environments. Manage the environments that support prototyping features across our Android and web applications alongside changes to one or more of our backend microservices.

  • API and event-driven architecture. Gatekeep the quality of our APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architecture in an open contributor model.

  • Agentic enablement. Continually improve our internal agentic harnesses (skills, context, and tooling) that allow other engineers and less technical colleagues to develop and prototype on our platform.

  • Agentic automation. Add agentic automation to all appropriate areas of the platform stack without compromising on quality.

 

About You

Must Have

  • Distributed systems experience. You've designed or meaningfully contributed to distributed backend systems, and understand event-driven patterns, asynchronous messaging, and the trade-offs at scale.

  • API design and evolution. You've designed APIs that other teams and clients depend on, and you understand the trade-offs between clean design, backwards compatibility, and speed.

  • Database and schema fluency. Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), including schema design, indexing, migrations, and query optimisation. Working knowledge of at least one non-relational store.

  • Real-time data. Experience processing or analysing real-time data streams at scale.

  • Cloud infrastructure. Experience deploying and operating distributed services on AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Shipping complex, customer-facing products at pace. Evidence that you can move real software into production quickly, making pragmatic decisions without letting perfection become a blocker.

  • Growth and ambition. A career that has moved fast, where you've taken on more scope sooner than the timeline would suggest.

  • AI-native engineering. You've shipped production code with frontier AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and push further into agentic workflows rather than push back on them.

 

Nice to Have (or We Can Teach)

  • Polyglot engineer. Professional software engineering experience across the stack, with your strongest work in the platform, and a portfolio of production systems you've owned end-to-end.

  • B2B or enterprise product experience. Background building for business or enterprise customers, where reliability, integrations, and data pipelines matter as much as the interface.

  • Product mindset. You care about the people using what you build, and you take ownership for what your team puts in front of them, not just the part you wrote.

  • Containers and orchestration. Docker and Kubernetes in production.

  • Retail or personalisation. Familiarity with retail technology, commerce platforms, or customer personalisation systems.

  • Startup experience. Background working at an early-stage startup.

 

How We Work

We're a startup, so this is a high-intensity environment. The people who thrive here are curious, proactive, and love building. If you're happiest when you're creating, experimenting, and moving fast, you'll love it here.

We draw our energy from being together, so this is an office-based role. It suits someone who enjoys the quick conversations and shared momentum that comes from building together. Our office is on what we think is the best garden square in London, just a couple of minutes from Tottenham Court Road, so it's easy to get to and a great place to build.

What We Offer

  • Direct access to our founders and a real voice in the calls that shape the product and the company.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

This is large-scale inference systems work: scheduling, fleet management, deployment pipelines, and reliability across clusters and hardware providers. It fits a strong systems engineer comfortable with model serving and Kubernetes at scale. If you want pure modeling rather than the systems that run models, this is firmly the systems side.

What You'll Own

  • Ship new model architectures by integrating them into the inference engine.

  • Collaborate across research, engineering, and infrastructure to optimize model efficiency and deployments.

  • Build internal tooling to measure, profile, and track the lifetime of inference jobs and workflows.

  • Automate, test, and maintain inference services for maximum uptime and reliability.

  • Manage and optimize inference workloads across clusters and hardware providers, and scale deployments across thousands of machines.

  • Build scheduling systems that use expensive GPU resources optimally while meeting SLOs, and maintain CI/CD for model checkpoints and SDKs.

First 90 Days

One way the first 90 could unfold.

  • Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Learn the inference stack, the fleets, and where reliability or utilization break.

  • Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Integrate a model or ship tooling/scheduling that improves uptime or GPU utilization.

  • Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Harden deployment pipelines and scheduling across clusters and providers.

What You Bring

  • Strong Python and system-architecture skills.

  • Experience deploying models with PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or similar.

  • Experience with queues, scheduling, traffic control, and fleet management at scale.

  • Experience with Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes, and with orchestration, deployment, and scheduling.

  • Familiarity with Redis and S3-compatible storage.

Nice to Have

  • Modern networking stacks including RDMA (RoCE, InfiniBand, NVLink).

  • High-performance large-scale ML systems (100+ GPUs).

  • CUDA, and FFmpeg or multimedia processing.

About Luma: Luma's mission is to build unified general intelligence that can generate, understand, and operate in the physical world. We believe multimodality is critical for intelligence — the next step beyond language models comes from vision. Luma is an equal opportunity employer.

  • Stay hands-on in the data and code when needed (Python/C++/SQL) to accelerate debugging and unblock delivery

  • Integrating new model features and architectures from core engineering into live Robotaxi operations

  • The stack underneath it all: WayveCode (Python + C++), Looker, Databricks/SQL, Grafana, and internal evaluation and sim tooling

  • In your first 90 days: mapping the top prioritised fixes across backend, robot, and driving model, and shipping a new driving model deployment and robot software release end-to-end

👤 You should apply if:

  • You bring a strong product and customer orientation, and can connect technical performance metrics to rider experience, operational outcomes, and launch readiness

  • You have strong autonomy/robotics performance debugging experience, including deep hands-on work with real-world issues and time-series/real-time signals, rather than just managing a queue

  • You have strong technical foundations in learned systems/ML-driven robotics, and can reason about model behaviour, failure modes, and measurement pitfalls in data-driven autonomy stacks

  • You're production-fluent in Python, C++, and SQL, comfortable working directly in code and analytics pipelines to diagnose problems and validate improvements

  • You have experience owning or co-owning releases to a fleet of robots/vehicles in production, including release processes, gates, rollback plans, and regression handling

  • You're familiar with modern data/observability stacks used in autonomy programs (e.g. Databricks/SQL, Grafana, internal eval/sim tooling)

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve's mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

📋 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Hiring manager Interview (30 mins)

We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

Our Mission

Join us in shaping the future of paid search intelligence.

Adthena is an award-winning search intelligence platform powered by patented AI technology and a team of dedicated experts. Our Whole Market View, Smart Monitor, and Local View solutions give clients the clarity to optimize spend, increase ROI, and stay ahead of the competition.

Trusted by global brands like Citibank, L’Oréal, and Volvo, and backed by Updata Partners, we’ve been redefining search intelligence since 2012.

In 2025, Adthena continued its winning streak, earning 8 major search industry awards. Highlights include Best AI Search Software Solution at the US Search Awards, Best Search Software Tool at the European Search Awards, and Best Software Innovation at the Global Search Awards.

Ready to make an impact in an industry-leading company? Let’s do it together.

Why Join Us?

We offer the best of both worlds: the maturity of a well-established company combined with the energy, agility, and impact of a scaling tech organisation.

We’re smaller than large-scale enterprises, offering more autonomy, less red tape, and accelerated growth.

Here’s what we offer:

  • Startup Engineering culture

  • Strong Culture: Our quarterly surveys show a 93% average approval rating for company culture, with an overall eNPS of 27.

  • Award-Winning Product: US 2025 Search Awards for Best AI Search Software Innovation

  • Stock Options: Our employees do incredible work, so as we grow, everyone shares the rewards.

  • Trust-Based Vacation: Take as much time off as you need, when you need it.

  • Remote-First: 52% of Adthenian’s work fully remote, with others choosing Hybrid Work at our 3 Geohubs (London, Austin, Sydney).

  • Flexible Work: Work how and where you do your best, with full autonomy over your day.

  • Career Growth: Bespoke training and career development via "Sherpa plans” to guide your growth.

  • Monthly Hackdays & Training Days

  • Family Care Package: Up to 6 months fully paid maternity leave, and 2 months paternity leave.

  • Home Office Stipend: $200 for your ideal remote setup.

  • Swag Welcome Gift: $70 credit to grab some merch.

  • Birthday Day Off: Celebrate your special day.

  • Regular Socials: Summer & Christmas parties, annual and quarterly offsites, monthly meet-ups. See here for more info.

  • Volunteer Days: Make a difference with paid volunteer time each quarter. See here for more info.

About the Role

Reporting to: Michal Gondar, Head of Engineering

Location: UK Remote

Interviews: 2 Stages

Start Date: ASAP

More info: See FAQ below, our candidate hub, or reach out to

What you’ll do at Adthena

As a Senior Anti-Bot Engineer, you will design, build, and operate large-scale, resilient web scraping systems, with a strong focus on Google and Google-like search environments.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, reverse engineering, and systems reliability, and is critical to delivering accurate, timely, and trustworthy data at scale.

You will work on complex scraping problems where naïve approaches do not work, including dynamic rendering, anti-bot defences, frequent markup changes, and high-volume data collection.

We are leaders in adopting coding with AI tools. The role is ideal for someone who believes in agentic coding and would like to improve their skills.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain large-scale Python scraping systems that operate reliably against Google and other highly defended websites

  • Build scrapers for dynamic, JavaScript-heavy pages using browser automation and hybrid approaches

  • Continuously adapt to changes in page structure, request flows, and anti-automation mechanisms

  • Engineer robust extraction pipelines that prioritise data accuracy, consistency, and observability

  • Implement proxy, fingerprinting, and request-routing strategies to maximise stability and throughput

  • Monitor scrape health, detect failures early, and rapidly debug production issues

  • Optimise performance, cost, and latency across scraping infrastructure

  • Work closely with data engineers, data scientists, and product teams to ensure scraped data is usable and trusted

  • Document scraping logic and operational runbooks for long-term maintainability

Required Experience:

  • Strong professional experience with Python (or another main language, i.e. GoLang, Rust, JavaScript) including production-grade scraping systems

  • Deep hands-on experience scraping Google or similarly protected platforms

  • Solid understanding of HTTP, TLS, cookies, headers, redirects, and browser networking behaviour

  • Experience with tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Puppeteer, or equivalent browser automation frameworks

  • Strong knowledge of HTML parsing, DOM traversal, and data extraction techniques

  • Experience handling rate limiting, CAPTCHA, IP rotation, and bot detection systems

  • Comfortable working with asynchronous and concurrent scraping architectures

  • Experience running scrapers at scale in cloud environments

  • Strong debugging skills and ability to reason about complex failure modes

  • Experience with headless browser fingerprinting and anti-bot evasion techniques

Nice To Have:

  • Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration, such as Docker and Kubernetes

  • Experience with distributed task systems and job queues

  • Background in data quality monitoring and anomaly detection

  • Experience working with search, advertising, or competitive intelligence data

What We Value

  • Pragmatic problem-solving in hostile and fast-changing technical environments

  • High ownership of systems that run continuously and at scale

  • A strong bias toward reliability, correctness, and observability

  • Ability to explain complex technical behaviour clearly to non-specialists

  • Curiosity about how large platforms evolve their defences and infrastructure

Our Core Values

All Adthenians are expected to align closely with our ‘Core Values’.

What it means...

  • Get Shit Done: We're big on taking action, owning our challenges, and finding solutions.

  • Freedom with Responsibility: We take charge of results to recognition. We know that our hustle not only moves the needle for the company but also sets us up for personal success.

  • Deliver Remarkable Quality: We care about exceeding expectations in the work we do and aim to always do our best work as individuals and as a team.

  • Smart & Always Improving: We strive daily to expand our knowledge and become better at what we do.

Meet your teammates

You’ll work closely with:

Michal Gondar
Head of Engineering

description: <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Abnormal AI is looking for a Customer Solutions Engineer to join the Technical Account Management team. This role gives Abnormal a flexible, technical resource for situations that fall between standard support and a long-term, dedicated Technical Account Manager. Customer Solutions Engineers are floating technical specialists who partner with CSMs for the duration of a specific need, triggered by things like recurring support cases, asks beyond the typical support experience, or short-term project-based work. The ideal candidate combines deep technical fluency with strong triage judgment and is comfortable moving between engagements without an existing playbook.</p> <h2>What you will do&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li>Serve as a flexible technical resource CSMs can bring into challenging or recurring account situations that a standard support case isn't built to resolve.</li> <li>Take on short-term, project-based technical engagements for customers without a dedicated TAM.</li> <li>Partner with CSMs to assess customer technical needs, join investigative or best-practices calls, and determine the right next step.</li> <li>Lead hands-on platform optimization: configuration reviews, best-practices setup, and proactive tuning that prevents issues from recurring.</li> <li>Document session recaps and next steps in the CRM so recommendations are clear to the customer and visible to the broader team.</li> <li>Advise customers on underused contracted features and flag upsell or professional services/deployment opportunities where relevant.</li> <li>Recognize when a situation exceeds this role's scope and hand it to the Critical Situation Manager or Technical Support with a clear, documented hand-off.</li> <li>Surface patterns across engagements to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to drive systemic improvement.</li> </ul> <h2>Must Haves&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li>3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (email infrastructure, IT security/administration, engineering, or technical support) in enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity</li> <li>Solid grounding in Abnormal's platform and configuration best practices, sufficient to work independently with customers without a senior technical resource in the room</li> <li>Strong triage judgment; able to recognize quickly whether a situation calls for hands-on technical guidance or a more senior technical resource</li> <li>Comfortable stepping into a customer relationship for a defined engagement and stepping back out; this is not a standing account-ownership role</li> <li>Able to manage multiple concurrent, time-bound engagements across a broad book of business rather than a fixed set of named accounts</li> <li>Excellent communication skills across technical and business stakeholders, including comfort presenting to senior customer stakeholders</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to Have&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li>Familiarity with email authentication/delivery protocols and cloud email platforms (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace)</li> <li>Prior experience in a floating/pooled technical resource model (e.g., professional services, deployment, or solutions engineering)</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-AA1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>A note on AI in our process:&nbsp;<br></strong>Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. Your Role

As a Senior or Staff-level Product Manager for Growth at bunch, you will lead a small Growth squad focused on discovering, validating, and shipping products that open the upmarket segment — larger VC funds and private equity managers whose scale and complexity put them beyond today’s product, but who become our most valuable customers the moment we can serve them.

This is greenfield work. You’ll start from real conversations with target accounts, not an inherited roadmap.

  • Own the Growth squad end to end: discovery, roadmap, build, and commercial outcomes

  • Work closely with Commercial to identify target accounts worth winning, then get in front of them through discovery calls, demos, and POC scoping

  • Identify recurring problems across upmarket accounts and decide what to build to deliver the highest ROI

  • Prototype fast — with the team and with AI tooling — so an idea becomes something a prospect can touch in weeks or months, not quarters

  • Run experiments knowing most will fail: kill the losers quickly and cheaply, and double down on what converts

  • Convert working prototypes into paid POCs, and paid POCs into signed contracts and product lines

  • Lead a small team of engineers as an active, hands-on product manager

About you

  • 7+ years in product, with a track record of taking ambiguous, zero-to-one problems to shipped, revenue-generating products

  • Experience operating at senior or staff level, with the ability to run a squad without someone setting direction for you

  • Strong fintech experience and comfort with financial services complexity, regulation, and sophisticated buyers

  • Commercial mindset: you think in business cases and ROI, can hold your own in front of a fund CFO or COO, and understand how discovery turns into POCs and signed contracts

  • Fluent with AI tools such as Claude, Lovable, or similar, especially for research, analysis, and prototyping

  • Experimental by temperament: energised by high-risk, high-reward work and able to design experiments so failures are fast and cheap

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and small teams; you would rather own one hard problem with two people than manage twenty on a roadmap someone else set

  • Exposure to private markets — VC, PE, fund administration, or working inside a GP or fund — is a plus

Success Indicators

  • A visible pipeline of experiments run, killed, or scaled, with clear reasoning for each

  • Paid MVPs landed with accounts previously out of reach

  • MVPs with a clear path to signed contracts in the upmarket segment

Workplace & Benefits

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 4 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & check initial fit

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (60 min) – Collaboration, ownership, and product/commercial fit

You are experienced in navigating the unique procurement processes of the defence sector in order to turn operational needs into concrete AI solutions. You have a proven track record of building trusted, long-term relationships with senior stakeholders and navigating strategic commercial conversations with confidence. You possess an entrepreneurial mindset, with the curiosity and drive to identify emerging opportunities and solve ambiguous, high-stakes challenges. You have the leadership maturity to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team, maintaining a focus on collective success and a high-performance culture. You possess a proven track record of managing complex deal processes and meeting ambitious revenue targets within a professional services or high-growth tech setting. You are a strategic thinker who can navigate the unique procurement processes of the defence sector and turn operational needs into concrete AI solutions. You have the leadership maturity to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team, maintaining a focus on collective success and a high-performance culture. This role will power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of predictions and accelerate the development of novel medicines. You will work across Translational Safety, in vivo Pharmacology and Biomarkers to drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain — from target assessment through to clinical support — continuously improving predictive accuracy and optimising dosing strategies for the target patient populations. Sitting within Relation's Drug Discovery team, this position is deeply embedded within cross-functional matrix project teams and will support multiple disease areas as our portfolio grows. In this position, you will play a critical role in the scientific advancement of nonclinical and clinical programmes by serving as the core quantitative and clinical pharmacology lead within project teams. You will drive all aspects of clinical pharmacology across all development phases and strategically apply Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) approaches to understand and translate non-clinical PK/PD into human drug development strategies, optimise trial design, justify dose selections, inform development decisions and mitigate risk across early and late-stage development. Your scope will be modality-agnostic, giving you oversight that spans small molecules, large molecules, and novel platforms. Act as the Clinical Pharmacology lead for multiple concurrent programmes across indications and therapeutic modalities. Oversee clinical pharmacology input into study design across the full range of development, with an initial focus on IND-enabling and dedicated Phase 1 clinical pharmacology trials, eventually leading into Phase 2 and 3 trials. Work across Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology and Biomarkers to integrate nonclinical and clinical data, continuously improving predictive accuracy. Lead modelling and simulation approaches, non-clinical to clinical PK/PD, DDI risk assessment, PBPK, population PK/PD and QSP approaches to characterise developability, exposure-response relationships, support dose and regimen selection and define quantitative criteria for data-driven decisions. Lead and manage external collaborations and CRO partnerships, ensuring effective execution, clear prioritisation and delivery against timelines, budgets and project goals. Author relevant sections of regulatory documents, including Investigator's Brochures, INDs and NDA/BLA/MAA submissions serving as the clinical pharmacology expert in interactions with regulators. Proactively identify and incorporate emerging AI-enabled approaches into clinical pharmacology workflows, using data analytics and evidence-based tools to sharpen decision-making. Interface closely with cross-functional teams, including DMPK, translational safety and toxicology, biology, clinical operations and regulatory affairs, to ensure clinical pharmacology considerations are embedded in development plans. Translate quantitative and biology data into clear, actionable insights, communicating findings effectively to project teams and senior stakeholders. Maintain rigorous documentation standards across modelling packages, protocols, and study reports. Champion Relation's collaborative, ambitious and science-driven culture, sharing quantitative expertise across the team and helping build an outstanding drug discovery organisation. Professionally, you will have A PhD, PharmD, or MD with a specialisation in DMPK, Pharmacometrics, in vivo/Clinical Pharmacology, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent industry experience in a lead Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology position. About the Role

Docker’s Professional Services team partners with customers to turn AI and cloud-native deployments into working production outcomes.

We are looking for a technically fluent Delivery Program Manager to operate delivery engagements. You will be embedded as an overlay alongside technical sales, solution architects, forward deployed engineers, and delivery partners, translating customers’ technical and business requirements into scoped service engagements and managing them through delivery.

 

You will be both builder and operator: designing repeatable service offerings where none exist today, and equally willing to roll up your sleeves to scope a detailed Statement of Work or unblock a stuck engagement. If you thrive in ambiguity, love building order from chaos, and operate with high autonomy and low ego, this role is for you.

 

What You'll Own

Delivery operations

  • Operationalize the end-to-end engagement lifecycle, from scoping and kickoff through delivery, handoff, and retrospectives.

  • Directly manage customer engagements: plan, run governance cadences, track milestones, manage risks and dependencies, and escalations.

  • Review technical assumptions in scopes and SOWs with solution architects (environments, integrations, identity, network and security constraints, customer prerequisites) so estimates and timelines hold up in delivery.

  • Own customer readiness and handoff: environment prerequisites, acceptance criteria, and clean transition to Support and Technical Account Managers.

 

Offerings and reusable assets

  • Partner with solution architects to create reusable delivery assets: playbooks, runbooks, statement of work templates, reference architectures, and onboarding workshops/guides.

  • Turn repeatable customer patterns into packaged, fixed-scope offerings with defined outcomes, durations and pricing inputs.

  • Build and maintain the sales-cycle engagement model and intake process for when and how Services are engaged across sales stages.

 

Governance, tooling, and metrics

  • Build the program management and governance infrastructure: intake frameworks, capacity planning models, risk registers, delivery dashboards, and milestone tracking.

  • Define and report delivery KPIs: on-time delivery, utilization, engagement margin, customer satisfaction.

  • Own SOW amendment and change-order processes: define when and how scope changes are documented, approved, and reflected in project tracking.

  • Partner with Legal on SOW frameworks and language.

 

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in technical program management, professional services, forward deployed engineering services or equivalent cross-functional roles.

  • Experience at a B2B SaaS, developer tooling, or infrastructure software company delivering implementation, migration, or adoption engagements to enterprise customers.

  • Demonstrated experience building programs, processes, or practices from scratch not just optimizing existing ones.

  • Strong technical fluency: comfortable participating in systems architecture discussions, understanding system dependencies.

  • Strong structured problem solving, facilitation, and systems thinking, including participation in

  • Experience with Professional Services tooling and business systems (e.g., Salesforce, NetSuite, PSA tools)

  • Exceptional written and verbal communicator able to produce executive-grade program readouts and customer-facing documentation alike.

  • High degree of personal accountability; comfortable owning ambiguous problems with limited oversight and providing value-added improvements.

     

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional services, consulting, or delivery experience at an infrastructure software vendor or systems integrator.

  • Experience self-serving data and analytics (Looker, Tableau, or similar) to build performance reporting.

  • Prior experience scaling a Professional Services or delivery organization or a support services operation through a growth or transformation phase.

  • Experience building engagements with third-party partners and system integrators within professional services delivery models.

Building a PS function from the ground up is rare. You will have broad scope, executive access, and the room to build something that matters.

  • Audit the existing SOW process and template library to identify gaps in standardization, approval routing, and tracking.

  • Identify the highest-priority SOW template gaps for standardization.

  • Document the current delivery framework as it exists today capturing what's working, and what needs to change.

  • Support leadership with quarterly review cycles on active engagements and retrospectives.

  • Translate process gaps into actionable workstreams with clear owners, timelines, and accountability.

title: Management Consulting, Head of AI and Technology
description: <h2>Role purpose</h2> <p>The Head of AI and Technology is accountable for the direction, delivery and adoption of AI across Teneo Management Consulting and for ensuring that its broader technology environment supports the needs of the business. The role sets the AI strategy and investment priorities, leads the AI Engineering team, owns the strategy and priorities for Management Consulting-specific technology, software, data, knowledge-management workflows and subscriptions, and acts as the principal Management Consulting stakeholder for Teneo IT on centrally managed technology, data platforms and services.</p> <p>The role connects Management Consulting's priorities with Teneo's central AI team, Teneo IT and other control and enabling functions. It translates business needs into Management Consulting-owned AI and technology initiatives or clear requirements for central teams, moves high-value AI and software solutions from experimentation into reliable use, and gives consultants the skills and support required to use approved AI tools effectively.</p> <p>It is primarily an internal capability role. The role is accountable for the allocation and utilisation of the AI Engineering team, including support for selected client engagements, and for the Management Consulting-specific AI and broader technology within its remit. Teneo IT and Teneo's central AI team remain accountable for the centrally managed services and capabilities, while Management Consulting engagement leaders retain accountability for client relationships, overall engagement delivery and revenue targets.</p> <h2>Key responsibilities</h2> <h3>AI strategy and priorities</h3> <ul> <li>Own the Management Consulting AI strategy, roadmap and priorities, aligned with the business strategy and Teneo-wide AI direction. Consult Teneo's central AI team on new solutions to reuse firm-wide capabilities, avoid duplication and manage enterprise dependencies.</li> <li>Identify and assess AI opportunities across consulting delivery, business development, proposition development, internal operations and knowledge work.</li> <li>Own prioritisation of AI opportunities and allocation of AI Engineering capacity within the approved budget, considering value, feasibility, risk, reuse potential, capacity and cost. Escalate material investments, major reprioritisation and strategically sensitive work to Management Consulting leadership.</li> <li>Develop business cases and recommend whether Management Consulting should build, buy, partner, reuse a central capability, scale an existing initiative or stop further investment.</li> <li>Define outcome measures for priority AI initiatives and report progress, realised value, adoption, spend, risks and dependencies to Management Consulting and wider Teneo leadership.</li> </ul> <h3>Leadership of the AI Engineering team</h3> <ul> <li>Lead the day-to-day work of the Management Consulting AI Engineering team, including objectives, prioritisation, resource allocation, workforce planning, utilisation, delivery oversight and performance management.</li> <li>Balance the team's capacity across client engagements, internal tooling development, enablement of the broader MC team, and technical capability improvement, while maintaining sustainable workloads.</li> <li>Set and enforce engineering and product standards for Management Consulting AI solutions, consistent with mandatory Teneo-wide architecture, AI, security and technology standards.</li> <li>Define clear demand, resourcing and decision-making processes between the AI Engineering team and key stakeholders, including Resourcing, Operations, Finance, project leads and the wider client-facing team.</li> <li>Build the team's capability through recruitment, coaching, feedback, career development and targeted use of external partners where justified.</li> <li>Maintain high practical AI fluency and sufficient technical understanding to create simple prototypes, automations and demonstrations, evaluate their outputs and translate business needs into clear engineering requirements, without becoming the bottleneck for implementation.</li> </ul> <h3>AI service lifecycle</h3> <ul> <li>Oversee the path from discovery and prototyping to production, adoption, support and retirement for Management Consulting AI solutions.</li> <li>Ensure solutions are designed for reuse where appropriate and integrate with approved data, identity, security and collaboration environments.</li> <li>Establish proportionate evaluation and monitoring for quality, reliability, user experience, cost and risk, including controls for generative AI outputs.</li> <li>Define ownership and support arrangements before launch, and ensure that technical debt, maintenance and business continuity inform investment and prioritisation decisions.</li> </ul> <h3>Business partnership and consulting integration</h3> <ul> <li>Partner with Management Consulting leadership and practice leads to translate business priorities into a focused AI agenda and secure decisions on investment, risk and operating change.</li> <li>Support proposition and methodology development by identifying where approved AI capabilities can improve the quality, speed or differentiation of consulting work.</li> <li>Advise case teams on feasible and responsible use of AI, deploying the AI Engineering team where specialist support is justified. Own the team's allocation and utilisation; engagement leaders remain accountable for client relationships and engagement delivery.</li> <li>Represent Management Consulting in relevant Teneo forums and maintain productive relationships with external technology and delivery partners.</li> </ul> <h3>Teneo IT partnership and centrally managed technology</h3> <ul> <li>Act as the principal Management Consulting stakeholder for Teneo IT, representing the business's needs and priorities in relation to centrally managed technology, data platforms and services.</li> <li>Translate Management Consulting requirements into clear input for firm-wide technology strategy, roadmaps and investment decisions, and communicate central plans, constraints and decisions to Management Consulting leadership.</li> <li>Coordinate with Teneo IT and relevant central functions on architecture, integration, identity and access, hosting, resilience, service support and technology changes affecting Management Consulting.</li> <li>Monitor the performance of centrally managed services within Management Consulting, escalating material issues and working with Teneo IT to agree appropriate action.</li> </ul> <h3>Management Consulting technology, knowledge management and subscriptions</h3> <ul> <li>Own the strategy, roadmap and priorities for Management Consulting-specific technology, software, data and subscriptions, aligned with business and AI priorities and Teneo-wide standards.</li> <li>Maintain a coherent view of Management Consulting applications, data sources, knowledge assets, licences and subscriptions, reducing duplication and addressing material capability gaps.</li> <li>Own selected technology-enabled knowledge-management workflows, including the capture, organisation, permissioning, retrieval and reuse of knowledge for consulting and AI-enabled workflows.</li> <li>Work with client-facing teams and designated knowledge owners to establish clear accountability for the quality, permissions and appropriate use of knowledge assets, while acting as a key stakeholder in wider knowledge-management decisions.</li> <li>Lead business cases, supplier evaluation, procurement and renewals for Management Consulting-specific tools and services. Manage approved expenditure, licences and consumption within delegated authority and the relevant central approval processes.</li> </ul> <h3>Training enablement and adoption</h3> <ul> <li>Set the AI capability-building plan for Management Consulting, based on the needs of different roles, practices and levels of experience.</li> <li>Direct practical training, guidance, demonstrations, office hours and communities of practice that help colleagues apply approved tools to real consulting workflows.</li> <li>Expand the network of leaders and super-users who can reinforce good practice, surface demand and support adoption within their teams.</li> <li>Measure confidence, active use, quality and workflow impact, and adapt the enablement programme where training does not translate into sustained behaviour change.</li> <li>Maintain clear communication on available tools, expected use, limitations, new releases and routes for support.</li> </ul> <h3>Responsible AI governance and risk</h3> <ul> <li>Consult Teneo's central AI team on proposed solutions to identify existing capabilities, avoid duplication and maintain alignment with Teneo-wide AI direction.</li> <li>Work with Cyber Security, Risk, Legal and IT to translate firm-wide requirements into practical delivery and usage controls.</li> <li>Ensure new AI solutions receive the required Cyber Security and Risk approvals prior to implementation, with clear records of decisions, exceptions and accountable owners.</li> <li>Promote safe handling of client and firm information and address emerging model, vendor and regulatory risks as the technology changes.</li> </ul> <h2>Experience and capabilities</h2> <ul> <li>Substantial experience setting and delivering an AI and technology strategy in a professional services, consulting or similarly knowledge-intensive environment.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and taking AI or software products from discovery into secure, supported production use, with the judgement to challenge decisions on architecture, integration, evaluation, security and operational support.</li> <li>High practical AI fluency, demonstrated through regular use of generative AI tools and the ability to create and evaluate simple prototypes, automations or workflows. Production coding experience is not required, but the candidate must recognise when specialist engineering support is needed.</li> <li>Evidence of converting ambiguous business needs into prioritised initiatives, investment cases, delivery plans and measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Experience of technology and data governance, including responsible AI, information security, privacy, vendor risk and approval processes.</li> <li>Experience improving data or knowledge-management workflows in a professional services or similarly knowledge-intensive environment, particularly where these support enterprise search, knowledge retrieval or AI-enabled use.</li> <li>Commercial judgement in build-versus-buy decisions, vendor selection, budgets, licences, subscriptions and consumption management.</li> <li>Experience designing enablement or change programmes that produce sustained adoption, rather than training attendance alone.</li> <li>Experience representing a business unit in relation to centrally managed technology services, translating requirements, explaining technical choices clearly and influencing enterprise technology priorities.</li> <li>Strong people leader: sets direction, develops talent, gives clear feedback and builds effective teams.</li> </ul> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content. </span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&amp;P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!</span></p></div><p><strong>Location: London (In office presence required 1-2 days a week)</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>The Customer Success organisation is composed of four teams: pre-sales, customer success managers, account management and support. The CS org is dedicated to ensuring every client realises the full value of their investment in our platform, working as an integrated partner to help clients achieve meaningful outcomes and embed AlphaSense into their everyday decision-making.</p> <p>By blending industry knowledge, product expertise, and a deep understanding of client priorities, the team helps organisations uncover new use cases, accelerate adoption, and sustain long-term growth. Their close engagement with clients also creates a powerful feedback loop—informing product innovation, shaping content strategy, and ensuring that the evolving needs of the corporate community are consistently reflected in how AlphaSense delivers value.</p> <p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Customer Success Manager (Sr. CSM) at AlphaSense, you will be the strategic lead for our most complex and high-value accounts within the Corporate sector. You are responsible for navigating multi-million dollar global organisations and driving long-term ROI through technical group/individual training while ensuring company-wide adoption across multiple business units. You will manage a concentrated portfolio of strategic accounts, remaining at the forefront of product and Corporate vertical expertise, while scaling your impact across the organisation through account strategy, leadership and innovation.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Account Influence:</strong> Navigate and influence multiple business units and key power users across the world largest and most complex global organisations. Create a groundswell of positive user sentiment to drive renewals and expansion with Senior Leadership.</li> <li><strong>Architect Deep Adoption &amp; Value Realization: </strong>Synthesise complex usage into actionable insights. Design multi-quarter adoption roadmaps in tandem with your Account Management peers that align AlphaSense capabilities with business objectives.</li> <li><strong>Onboarding &amp; Ongoing Training:</strong> As an expert on the product, you will guide new clients through onboarding, training, and best-practice adoption to ensure a strong foundation, both virtually and in person.</li> <li><strong>Technical &amp; Domain Mastery:</strong> Independently lead sophisticated technical conversations regarding Managed Content Providers (MCP), APIs, and Large Language Models (LLMs) with technical stakeholders and platform owners.</li> <li><strong>Executive Presence &amp; Communication:</strong> Command virtual and in-person rooms with executive presence, and leverage powerful, strategic follow-ups as a tool to drive adoption and link AlphaSense to specific Senior Leader business objectives.</li> <li><strong>Solo On-Site Leadership:</strong> Fully own high-stakes, multi-day on-site engagements and lead customer "Lunch &amp; Learns,’’ tailoring presentations to diverse user groups and core personas using our WWH (Why, What, How) framework.</li> <li><strong>Company Innovation:</strong> engage in cross-functional initiatives outside the standard CSM scope, such as product feedback loops, hiring committees, mentorship programs and process innovation to improve team efficiency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>4 -6+ years of professional experience in Customer Success or Account Management, with a proven track record of managing a strategic portfolio.&nbsp;</li> <li>Recognised as a "Vertical Expert".&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to travel 20% of time.&nbsp;</li> <li>Possess the technical acumen to navigate complex conversations around data integrations, APIs, and AI-driven market intelligence solutions.</li> <li>Ability to identify the 5% of users who drive the majority of sentiment and influence within an account, focusing on high-level business outcomes over basic feature adoption.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with a demonstrable track record for collaborating internally in a cross-functional environment and onsite with customers.&nbsp;</li> <li>A natural leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and is committed to contributing to the "AlphaSense Playbook" through mentorship and internal innovation.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Recruiting Scams and Fraud</span></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">All official communications will come from an @<a href="http://alpha-sense.com/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://alpha-sense.com/&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1740162734907000&amp;usg=AOvVaw2sfhQUZloRzVpQ4Yj1Ftlo">alpha-sense.com</a>&nbsp;email address.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.alpha-sense.com/careers/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.alpha-sense.com/careers/&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1740162734907000&amp;usg=AOvVaw3I0CFwb1ser7ImCRD48YOl">Careers page</a>.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
