title: Sr. Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Are</strong></span></p> <p>Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.</p></div><h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h4> <p>The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.</p> <p>As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.</p> <p>This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi-day engagements.</p> <p>Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You'll Do</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Build AI-powered agents and tools end-to-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production</li> <li>Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval-augmented workflows</li> <li>Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain-specific</li> <li>Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality</li> <li>Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client-specific work into product features</li> <li>Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines)</li> <li>Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who You Are</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Extensive professional software engineering experience</li> <li>Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language)</li> <li>Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs</li> <li>Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data-grounded AI workflows</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)</li> <li>You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified.</li> <li>A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate.</li> <li>You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code does</li> <li>BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Nice to Have</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Experience building agentic systems (multi-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows)</li> <li>Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment)</li> <li>Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting)</li> <li>Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container-based deployments</li> <li>Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Our Values&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.</span></li> <li><strong>Build Together - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.&nbsp;</span></li> <li><strong>Champion Our Clients - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.&nbsp;</span></li> <li><strong>Drive Innovation - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.&nbsp;</span></li> <li><strong>Embrace Learning - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to <a ---------- Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive
description: <p><strong>Soho, London&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office Tues - Thurs</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Sitting within LiveScore Media’s Acquisition team, this role focuses driving user growth and supporting commercial revenue across key markets. You will manage and scale performance marketing campaigns across digital channels, with a primary focus on driving app downloads. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will turn growth plans into measurable campaigns that engage sports fans.</p> <p>This position gives you the opportunity to test new channels and acquisition tactics aswe strengthen our global footprint. Adapting platform algorithm changes and tailoring campaigns to distinct local audiences represent the core challenges of the role. Success is evaluated through achieving acquisition volume and CPA/ROAS targets, while ensuring efficient budget allocation and continuous improvement in campaign performance.</p> <p>At LiveScore Group, we’re the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We’re proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and our passion drives us to the top. We don’t just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it’s our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition. As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. If you’re good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users.</p> <p><em>We know that job descriptions can sometimes seem daunting, and you might not feel you tick every box. But, if you’re passionate about the role and have relevant experience, we want to hear from you!</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage and optimise performance marketing campaigns across app marketing, paid social, and display channels to drive user acquisition.</li> <li>Collaborate with brand and creative teams to produce, review, and deliver marketing assets that align with brand standards and drive conversions.</li> <li>Track and allocate digital marketing budgets across channels to meet commercial acquisition targets while maintaining spend efficiency.</li> <li>Set up and evaluate A/B and multivariate tests across creative assets, messaging, and landing pages to improve campaign performance.</li> <li>Analyse campaign data and conversion funnels to share clear, actionable performance reports with team leads and key stakeholders.</li> <li>Handle routine campaign financial administration, including raising purchase orders and processing invoices with internal finance teams.</li> <li>Ensure all digital advertising campaigns strictly comply with applicable industry regulations, territorial licensing guidelines, and age verification standards.</li> <li>Work collaboratively with external media partners, ad platforms, and creative agencies to coordinate campaign launches smoothly.</li> <li>Test and evaluate emerging digital marketing channels and audience targeting methods to support ongoing user growth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills, Knowledge and Experience</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience running and optimising paid acquisition campaigns across mobile app marketing, paid social, or display channels.</li> <li>Experience managing digital media spend against agreed CPA and ROAS performance targets.</li> <li>Practical understanding of conversion tracking mechanics, attribution models, and event mapping.</li> <li>Clear understanding of digital marketing measurement and attribution methodologies, including conversion tracking and the ability to interpret campaign performance data. Experience with Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) is highly desirable.</li> <li>Experience designing and running A/B tests to improve ad performance and conversion rates.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to take ownership of campaign deliverables and manage project timelines independently.</li> <li>Clear communication and collaboration skills when working with cross-functional teams and external suppliers.</li> <li>A proactive, curious and adaptable approach, with a willingness to learn new platforms, embrace AI-powered tools, explore emerging technologies and continuously develop digital marketing expertise.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What can we offer?&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Company Performance Bonus</li> <li>Flexible Working Agreements where applicable</li> <li>Private Healthcare Scheme + Employee Enhanced Assistance</li> <li>Enhanced Family Leave - Maternity, Shared Parental &amp; Adoption Leave: up to 6 months at full pay and 6 months at half pay. Paternity leave: up to 4 weeks at full pay</li> <li>Subsidised Gym Membership</li> <li>Annual Travel Card Loan &amp; Ride to Work Scheme</li> <li>Life Assurance (x3 salary)</li> <li>Contributory Pension Plan</li> <li>Virgin Family: Giving you access to exclusive Virgin offers and experiences</li> <li>Thursday drinks in the office and regular socials</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Netcraft</strong></p> <p>Netcraft is the global leader in cybercrime detection and disruption. We’re a trusted partner for three of the four largest companies in the world and many large governments. We've blocked over 225 million cyber-attacks to date, and we take down around 33% of the world's phishing attacks.</p> <p>Our purpose and passion are focused on just one thing: protecting the world from cybercrime.</p> <p>That passion shapes how we work, too. We’re proud of our talented team and the value each person brings, and we’ve built a workplace where people feel supported and inspired. From strong benefits and wellness programs to meaningful collaboration and team connection.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><div id="message-list_1778797102.223239"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><strong>The Role </strong><br>Reporting directly to the Director of Sales and working closely with colleagues across the UK and other global teams, this role is wholly focused on winning net new corporate customers across the EMEA region.<br>This is a pure new business role. You will be responsible for&nbsp;identifying, developing, and closing high-value opportunities with net new customers, operating with a high degree of ownership across the full new business sales cycle.<br><br><strong>Why join Netcraft’s commercial team? </strong><br>You will be joining a high-performing commercial organisation with a strong track record of growth and execution. Over recent years, the team has consistently delivered against target, with:</div> <ul> <li>100%+ attainment against ARR targets across multiple years</li> <li>90%+ of fully ramped Account Executives exceeding annual targets in 2025</li> <li>60%+ year-on-year growth in New Sales ARR in 2025</li> <li>Several of the largest new business deals in company history closed in recent quarters</li> </ul> <div><strong>This is what you’ll be doing, day to day:&nbsp;</strong></div> <ul> <li>Driving net new business across the EMEA region and securing contracts with new corporate customers against target</li> <li>Owning the full sales cycle from initial engagement through to close</li> <li>Building and maintaining strong pipeline coverage through a combination of self-generated outbound activity and qualified inbound opportunities</li> <li>Prospecting daily through channels such as email, LinkedIn, phone, and strategic outreach</li> <li>Engaging senior stakeholders to understand business challenges and requirements, particularly in relation to cybersecurity and digital risk</li> <li>Leading commercial conversations and positioning Netcraft’s value clearly in complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles</li> <li>Drafting and delivering compelling proposals, working closely with technical teams where needed to address customer requirements</li> <li>Maintaining accurate pipeline visibility and ensuring Salesforce is updated consistently with high-quality activity and account notes</li> <li>Providing feedback and ideas on ways to shorten sales cycles, improve sales effectiveness, and strengthen Netcraft’s market positioning</li> <li>Conducting all sales activities with a high degree of professionalism, credibility, and integrity</li> </ul> <div><strong>What you’ll need to be successfu</strong>l</div> <ul> <li>Consistent success exceeding quota in complex, long-cycle sales environments</li> <li>A strong track record of measurable achievement, ideally including top-performer recognition such as President’s Club or similar</li> <li>Significant experience in quota-carrying corporate B2B sales roles, with a strong track record of winning net new business and closing high-value deals</li> <li>Proven ability to generate pipeline independently and create opportunities through proactive outbound activity</li> <li>Strong commercial and discovery skills, with the ability to identify customer needs, build urgency, and progress opportunities effectively</li> <li>Experience selling into regulated industries and/or in cybersecurity, digital risk, fraud, SaaS, or similarly complex technical environments would be highly valuable</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage confidently at senior and executive level</li> <li>Strong presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills</li> <li>A high-ownership mindset, with the ability to organise, prioritise, and manage activity effectively, including customer travel where needed</li> <li>Familiarity with Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform</li> <li>A genuine interest in cybersecurity and the ability to build credibility quickly in a technically nuanced market</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>The Reward Package:</strong></p> <div class="ewa-rteLine"> <ul> <li>33 days annual leave - includes public holidays which can be worked if you prefer</li> <li>Generous enhanced family leave and pay</li> <li>Enhanced company sick pay from day one of employment, with additional support after your first six months’ service</li> <li>Salary sacrifice pension with matched employer contributions up to 5% + NI savings</li> <li>Private health cover, including access to a private GP service</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4 x salary</li> <li>Equity tracking scheme (eligibility criteria apply) - allowing you share in Netcraft's long term success</li> description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the role We're looking for a seasoned Senior PR Manager to own Perk's US and UK media presence. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of our most important strategic priorities: establishing Perk as a leading voice in major business and financial press. Both markets are fast-growing for Perk, and cutting through in either requires deep journalist relationships, a sharp corporate narrative, and someone who can work at the pace of a major news cycle. You'll be the on-the-ground force behind our Tier 1 media strategy, shaping how our executives show up in the press and building the kind of earned presence no paid campaign can replicate. This is a role for a natural communicator who understands the nuance of financial and business media, can translate complex tech and AI narratives into compelling stories, and knows how to get a C-suite executive ready for a Bloomberg interview on short notice. What you'll do Own the US and UK media strategy: Lead Perk's day-to-day PR activity from proactive pitching and newsjacking to reactive press office and crisis communications. You'll be the primary point of contact for US and UK journalists and the go-to expert on those media landscapes internally. Build and deepen Tier 1 relationships: Cultivate and maintain genuine relationships with journalists at WSJ, Bloomberg, the FT, CNBC, Forbes and beyond — not just for coverage, but for the kind of background briefings and exclusives that build long-term credibility. Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences. Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most. Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press. Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it. Bring AI into the workflow : Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice. What we're looking for Experience Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast) Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account Strong background in B2B technology, fintech or SaaS essential Skills Sharp editorial judgement — knows what makes a story Strong writer — press releases, bylines, executive commentary and media briefings all to a high standard Confident media trainer and spokesperson coach for C-suite executives Comfortable working with data (survey results, product analytics, market research) and shaping it into a clear, pitchable narrative Commercially minded — understands how PR contributes to pipeline, brand salience and competitive positioning Comfortable building AI into day-to-day PR workflows (drafting, research, monitoring, reporting) to work faster without sacrificing judgement or quality. Ways of working Self-starter who can own a US and UK PR programme independently and support the Director of Communications on corporate and financial priorities, while collaborating closely with a global team Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted What we offer Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume. Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you. AI at Perk

description: <p>Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.</p> <h3>Why this role</h3> <p>You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.</p> <ul> <li><strong>High trust.</strong> You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.</li> <li><strong>High visibility.</strong> Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.</li> <li><strong>High freedom.</strong> You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.</li> <li><strong>Fast iteration.</strong> We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.</li> </ul> <h3>Your mission</h3> <p>Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the role

The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the center of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced, strategic Engagement Manager to join our growing team and help a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams fundamentally change the way they work with Legora.

This is a role for someone who has developed and executed a scaled customer motion, and who knows that transformation across a large portfolio of clients has to be designed, automated and measured. You will drive adoption, technical health and commercial outcomes of your portfolio end-to-end by leveraging systems and technology while reserving high-touch interactions for the most impactful moments.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption program at Legora, helping clients realize measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.

 

What You'll Do:

You'll own the post-sale motion end-to-end for a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams across our EMEA scaled portfolio. Specifically, you will:

  • Improve the scaled adoption playbook: the tech-led onboarding, enablement, and change-management motions and target outcomes for how our scale customers adopt Legora and transform the way they work.

  • Execute against that playbook, sequencing automated touchpoints and interventions from initial rollout to firm-wide adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve.

  • Facilitate strategic touchpoints with your highest stakes accounts, while using one-to-many enablement to surface high-impact opportunities and guide the rest of the portfolio toward maximum value from Legora.

  • Drive sustained value through a programmatic operating cadence: templated success plans, one-to-many enablement, scaled training and digital value reviews.

  • Manage the health of the portfolio by monitoring adoption and utilization signals in our internal systems to proactively flag and act on risks and growth opportunities.

  • Own the commercials for the scaled program end-to-end by running renewal and expansion as repeatable motions informed by exquisite portfolio hygiene, forecasting, and data utilization.

  • Orchestrate engagement across cross-functional teams (Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Product Marketing, Support) to accelerate client success, maintaining end-to-end portfolio context and coordination.

raw.description:
About the Job

Join Excelya, where Audacity, Care, and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating bold solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand.

This role is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a dynamic, ambitious team Medical Affairs. You will play a critical part in driving innovation and making an impact in the clinical research space, while enjoying a stimulating professional environment that encourages personal and intellectual growth.

The Medical Data Officer works in close collaboration with the Study Medical

Reviewer and participates in managing/reviewing the medical consistency of

reported clinical data to ensure that medical data in database are accurate, reliable

and analyzable.

Main Responsibilities

  1. Study Setup Tasks


* Protocol Review especially topics linked to safety management, specific data that could need to be coded, inclusion, selection criteria, study design, pathology and mechanism of action of the IMP


* Database specification review and User acceptance test on eCRF, and Database validation tools used for medical review


* Participate in identification of Important Protocol Deviation detection method and their implementation (specifications, and UAT)

  1. Study Conduct Tasks

 
* Medical Coding of Adverse Events, medical and surgical history, other specific events and all treatments, including treatment indication.

* Medical Review might check the medical data entered by the investigator using available tools and processes and can create manual queries for clarification, confirmation, or correction if needed.



*Identify all non-serious adverse events according to strategy defined at the start of the study
* Handle the extraction process to support data available for important study milestones

Requirements

About You

At Excelya, taking audacious steps is encouraged, so we’re looking for individuals who are ready to grow with us and share our values.

• Experience: Junior or preferable 12 months experience related to clinical trials and therapeutic development

• Skills:

Curiosity and investigation mindset. Good interpersonal and communication skills; well organized, prioritization.

• Education: Medical Doctor, Pharmacist or scientist

• Languages: Fluency in English

title: Account Manager Lille
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Pourquoi Deliveroo ? Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent. Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d'un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre! Tes principales missions :   Gérer un portefeuille de restaurants clés sur des zones matures, où l'expertise et l'attention au détail font toute la différence. Développer des partenariats privilégiés et durables en devenant le point de contact expert de votre zone et en mettant à profit vos connaissances Food Tech. Optimiser la performance de vos comptes grâce à un accompagnement personnalisé, construit sur le long terme et nourri par la data. Analyser les résultats de vos restaurants, identifier les leviers d'amélioration et recommander des actions concrètes à votre manager tout en restant agile et ouvert à la nouveauté. Proposer et mettre en place des campagnes marketing et promotionnelles ciblées pour booster l'attractivité de vos restaurants partenaires. Suivre de près le déroulé des opérations afin de garantir la meilleure expérience restaurant et client possible. Ton expérience et tes qualités : Tu as déjà 2 à 3 ans d'expérience sur un rôle similaire où la gestion d'un portefeuille de partenaires était centrale à ta mission. Tu sais négocier et anticiper les discussions commerciales tout en gardant à l'esprit les valeurs de Deliveroo. Tu sais garder le contrôle de ton portefeuille , identifier les nouvelles tendances du marché et partager du feedback utile à tes partenaires ainsi qu'à ton manager. Le terrain est un lieu où tu te sens à ta place : tu sais construire des relations de confiance avec tes partenaires tout en gardant un œil attentif sur la concurrence. Tu sais te montrer proactif , analyser les résultats de tes actions et proposer des recommandations concrètes à ton manager. Tu travailles de manière autonome tout en gardant le cap fixé, sais t'approprier des objectifs précis et mets tout en œuvre pour les atteindre. Tu sais concevoir des actions spécifiques , adaptées à la fois aux besoins de tes partenaires et à la stratégie définie par ton manager. Tu sais identifier, comprendre et analyser les données de performance (commerciales et opérationnelles) pour garantir un niveau de service irréprochable. Tu sais t'exprimer en anglais (à l'oral comme à l'écrit) Tu arrives à convaincre tout en construisant des relations commerciales solides, durables, où Deliveroo devient le partenaire de choix Et si tu cherches un poste où tu travailles en full remote depuis Lille , tout en gardant un lien fort avec le terrain et les équipes, alors c'est peut‑être le rôle qu'il te faut ! La vie chez Deliveroo Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix. Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel. Avantages et diversité À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l'article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité professionnelle, l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. Deliveroo France valorise la diversité sans discrimination de genre, race, sexualité, religion ou préférences personnelles. Avec un score de 99/100 à l'Indice de l'Égalité Hommes-Femmes 2023, nous sommes engagés envers l'égalité des chances. Rejoignez-nous avec votre passion pour la nourriture dans une entreprise en pleine croissance. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! We are looking for an engineer first. This is a practitioner role for someone who has already lived this shift, who experiments constantly, who knows what works and what doesn't, and who can bring 60 engineers along on that journey. You will join the XTM Foundation team as Filigran's internal reference on AI-Native engineering. You'll be the one tracking it, filtering the noise, and surfacing what actually matters for a team like ours. Work in the XTM Foundation team to turn AI practices into shared building blocks for every product team: agent workflows in our CI pipelines (dependency updates, flaky test triage, review assistance), shared MCP servers and prompt libraries, versioned AI configuration in the repositories, and written rules on tools and data handling that apply to everyone. Contribute to Filigran's external voice on AI-Native engineering — blog posts, open-source contributions, conference talks — as the opportunity arises. 🤝 Who You'll Work With Reports to: Principal Engineer of XTM Foundation team. Key collaborators: Engineers and Engineering Managers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, and OpenGRC product teams; VP of Technology; CTO. You've already transformed how you build software, you can show what you built and what you measured, and you want to help others do the same. Proven experience deploying AI-assisted development practices within an engineering team: you've done this before, you know what resistance looks like, and you know what actually works and what doesn't. Autonomy and ownership mindset: you drive this agenda without waiting for direction, and you bring others with you rather than working alone. Bonus: experience with open-source communities, cybersecurity domain knowledge, contributions to AI tooling projects, or public writing/speaking on AI-Native engineering. 🌱 Why Join Filigran? raw.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is genuinely, deeply convinced that AI is transforming the way software gets built, and who wants to make that transformation happen at Filigran.

We are looking for an engineer first. This isn't a "we bought Copilot, please roll it out" role, and it isn't only a tooling or development role either: part of the job is building, part of it is trying things on real work, measuring them and telling teams honestly what works and what doesn't. This is a practitioner role for someone who has already lived this shift, who experiments constantly, who knows what works and what doesn't, and who can bring 60 engineers along on that journey.

You will join the XTM Foundation team as Filigran's internal reference on AI-Native engineering. You'll propose our approach, build our practices, run experiments, and share the results so that teams can change how they work with confidence. You'll be hands-on, opinionated, and always one step ahead.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Define and own Filigran's AI-Native engineering strategy: which tools, which workflows, which practices, and how they evolve as the landscape moves fast.

  • Run structured experiments to evaluate new AI coding tools and agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline, MCP servers, code generation agents…), measure their real impact on velocity and quality, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Build the guardrails and engineering standards that ensure AI-generated code is maintainable, tested, and consistent with our quality bar — not just fast to produce.

  • Work directly with product engineering teams (~80 engineers) to embed AI practices into their day-to-day workflows: pair programming with AI, AI-assisted code review, test generation, documentation, and beyond.

  • Share what you learn. Run internal talks, workshops, and demos. Be the person engineers come to when they want to understand what's possible, and what isn't. Show real results, including the failures.

  • Stay permanently ahead of the curve — the AI tooling landscape moves weekly. You'll be the one tracking it, filtering the noise, and surfacing what actually matters for a team like ours.

  • Work in the XTM Foundation team to turn AI practices into shared building blocks for every product team: agent workflows in our CI pipelines (dependency updates, flaky test triage, review assistance), shared MCP servers and prompt libraries, versioned AI configuration in the repositories, and written rules on tools and data handling that apply to everyone.

  • Contribute to Filigran's external voice on AI-Native engineering — blog posts, open-source contributions, conference talks — as the opportunity arises.

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • Reports to: Principal Engineer of XTM Foundation team.

  • Key collaborators: Engineers and Engineering Managers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, and OpenGRC product teams; VP of Technology; CTO.

  • Working model: You will split your time between XTM Foundation team work (research, experimentation, standards) and direct collaboration with product teams to embed AI practices in real engineering workflows.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience — you are a strong engineer first. You understand what good code looks like, and that's what makes your judgment on AI credible.

  • You are genuinely AI-first in how you work. Not as a trend, not as a productivity hack. You've already transformed how you build software, you can show what you built and what you measured, and you want to help others do the same.

  • Proven experience deploying AI-assisted development practices within an engineering team: you've done this before, you know what resistance looks like, and you know what actually works and what doesn't.

  • Deep, hands-on familiarity with the current AI coding tooling landscape: agentic coding tools, LLM-powered code review, prompt engineering for development workflows, MCP ecosystems, and what's coming next.

  • Strong full-stack engineering background — you can evaluate AI output across the whole stack and contribute code yourself when it matters.

  • You can make a clear case, with evidence. You're a natural communicator who can discuss a trade-off with a skeptical senior engineer just as well as you can help a junior developer get started.

  • Comfortable working in a remote-first, async culture with teams across multiple time zones; clear communicator in English.

  • Autonomy and ownership mindset: you drive this agenda without waiting for direction, and you bring others with you rather than working alone.

  • Bonus: experience with open-source communities, cybersecurity domain knowledge, contributions to AI tooling projects, or public writing/speaking on AI-Native engineering.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring a Direct Tax Lead to own our US income tax provision, compliance, and controls, reporting to the Head of Tax. ElevenLabs operates through its US entity and ~9 international entities and is growing fast, which means the provision, the compliance calendar, and the controls around them need a dedicated owner.

This is a hands-on ownership role. The provision and returns are prepared by external providers; you manage those engagements and are accountable for the output. You'll own the quarterly and annual ASC 740 provision (deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate rec, footnote disclosures), the US federal and state compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimated payments), and the technical work underneath it: §174 capitalization, §382 and NOL tracking.

You'll also assist in designing, documenting, and operating controls, and write the memos that support our positions, working directly with our Big 4 advisors and external auditors alongside the Head of Tax.

Requirements

  • Deep ASC 740 expertise at a multinational — provision, deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate reconciliation, and footnote disclosure

  • Experience owning a US federal and multistate compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimates)

  • Working knowledge of US international provisions (NCTI/GILTI, Subpart F, FDDEI, §163(j)) and how they flow into the provision

  • Experience managing Big 4 or equivalent providers and working directly with external auditors

  • Has built or operated SOX controls over tax, or supported a first SOX implementation

  • CPA

Bonus: pre-IPO or first-10-K experience, §174/§41 computation, §382 studies, equity compensation tax (ISOs, NSOs, RSUs), OneSource Tax Provision or similar.

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Build and lead the direct tax team as we bring provision and compliance in-house

  • Expand into other strategic initiatives such as M&A, PE mitigation policy, corporate structuring.

  • Broaden into wider tax leadership as our footprint grows

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the east coast, New York preferred.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Deep fluency in banking and insurance regulation (model risk, third-party risk, data protection, consumer protection), which you can speak to without a briefing

Location

About the role ElevenLabs is looking for a Value Strategist to help our customers identify, quantify, and realize the business value of ElevenLabs across our portfolio, with a primary focus on ElevenAgents. This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. You will work directly with customers and prospects to understand their businesses, build the case for investment, and establish how that value will be measured over time. On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper. This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations. You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally. In this role you will Shape value from the beginning. Partner with Revenue teams and prospects early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify high-value opportunities, and establish the business case for investing in ElevenLabs. Build our global value strategy. Develop the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, discovery approaches, and playbooks that define how ElevenLabs approaches value across industries and use cases. Scale what works. Turn bespoke work with our largest customers into repeatable approaches that enable our Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial teams to articulate and measure value without requiring bespoke support for every customer. Identify where ElevenLabs can have the greatest impact. Develop a deep understanding of a customer's business, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities to determine which use cases have the greatest potential and why. Quantify the opportunity. Build rigorous financial and operational models that translate ElevenLabs use cases into measurable outcomes across revenue, cost, productivity, customer experience, and other relevant dimensions. Define how value will be proven. Establish success metrics and measurement approaches for proofs of concept and deployments so that customers and ElevenLabs have a shared understanding of what success looks like from the outset. Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist. Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact. Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications. Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement. Influence senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analysis simply and credibly, and engage with senior leaders internally and externally when the opportunity requires it. Requirements 10+ years of relevant experience across operating roles, strategy, management consulting, analytics, finance, customer strategy, or other roles requiring rigorous business problem solving. Strong operating judgment. You understand how businesses work and can quickly get underneath a customer's operating model, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities. Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions. Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it. Customer credibility. You can work directly with customers across functions and levels, ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and establish trust quickly. Commercial judgment. You understand how business value connects to technology investment decisions and can partner closely with Revenue teams while maintaining an objective, customer-first perspective. Excellent communication. You can distill complex analysis into a clear point of view and communicate it effectively in writing and verbally, from working teams through senior executives. A builder mentality. You are excited to start by doing the work yourself, learn from customers, and turn what works into scalable methodologies and tools. Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can move quickly across industries, customer types, and use cases while maintaining a high bar for analytical rigor. Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable partnering with teams and customers across regions and traveling when valuable for customer work. Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time. Bonus points Experience in strategy or management consulting, particularly in operational transformation, technology, customer experience, or growth. Experience as an operator within a technology company or other fast-moving business. Experience working on AI, automation, customer experience, or technology-enabled business transformation. Experience developing business cases, value frameworks, or analytical methodologies that were ultimately scaled beyond an individual project or customer. Experience working with enterprise customers on complex, cross-functional initiatives. Location This is a global role within the Revenue organization. The role can be based in San Francisco or remotely, with the option to work from our San Francisco office. You will work with customers and ElevenLabs teams across regions and should expect travel for customer meetings and onsite work when it meaningfully advances the work. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Au sein du Département Automatique, Productique et Informatique, le poste sera associé à l’équipe TASC (Théorie, Algorithmes et Systèmes en Contraintes ) dont les thématiques de recherche s’articulent autour de la programmation par contraintes, de la théorie aux applications en passant par l’hybridation. Dans ce cadre, le poste a pour objectif de venir en soutien au développement du solveur de contraintes choco-solver ( http://choco-solver.org ) maintenu par l’équipe TASC.   MISSIONS Sous la responsabilité fonctionnelle du responsable du projet et développeur principal de la plateforme Choco-solver et en collaboration avec les membres de l’équipe TASC, les missions principales du poste sont :   Adapter l’algorithme bimodal aux contraintes reposant sur des parcours en profondeur, telles que GlobalCardinality, StableKeysort ou Circuit ;   Étudier la transposition des bénéfices de l’approche bimodale au cœur d’un solveur de contraintes (p. ex. le moteur de propagation) ;   Évaluer l’impact des explications paresseuses (lazy) dans les contraintes Sum et AllDifferent, entre autres ;   Participer à la rédaction d’articles scientifiques liés à ces sujets.     ACTIVITÉS : Activité par mission        Adapter l’algorithme bimodal aux contraintes reposant sur des parcours en profondeur ·       Analyse les algorithmes de filtrage de GlobalCardinality, StableKeysort et Circuit disponibles dans choco-solver et identifie les parcours en profondeur (composantes fortement connexes, chemins alternants, etc.) susceptibles de bénéficier de l’approche bimodale ·       Conçoit et implémente en Java les variantes bimodales de ces algorithmes, en garantissant le niveau de cohérence attendu ·     Vérifie la correction des implémentations par des tests unitaires et des tests aléatoires comparant les résultats avec les propagateurs existants ·       Mesure les gains obtenus (temps de filtrage, passage à l’échelle) sur des jeux d’instances de référence (XCSP3, MiniZinc Challenge) ·       Intègre les développements validés dans la version publique de choco-solver (revue de code, documentation, intégration continue)   2.      Étudier la transposition des bénéfices de l’approche bimodale au cœur d’un solveur de contraintes ·       Étudie le fonctionnement interne de choco-solver (moteur de propagation, ordonnancement des propagateurs, gestion des événements) afin d’identifier les mécanismes pouvant tirer parti d’une stratégie bimodale ·       Propose et prototype une ou plusieurs adaptations, par exemple un basculement dynamique entre modes de propagation ·       Évalue expérimentalement ces prototypes et analyse les compromis entre coût et bénéfice   3.      Évaluer l’impact des explications paresseuses ( ·       Implémente ou étend la génération paresseuse d’explications pour les contraintes Sum, AllDifferent et d’autres contraintes globales ·       Compare les explications paresseuses aux explications calculées pendant la propagation (taille des clauses apprises, temps de résolution, nombre de nœuds explorés) ·       Conçoit et conduit un protocole expérimental reproductible, puis analyse et synthétise les résultats   4.      Participer à la rédaction d’articles scientifiques liés à ces sujets. ·       Rédige en anglais des articles scientifiques présentant les contributions, en vue de soumissions à des conférences (CP, IJCAI, AAAI, CPAIOR) ou revues (Constraints) internationales ·       Prépare les artefacts expérimentaux associés (code, scripts, données) afin d’assurer la reproductibilité des résultats ·       Présente les travaux en séminaire d’équipe et, le cas échéant, en conférence   FORMATION ET Bac + 3 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 6 ans ·       Diplôme Bac + 2 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 10 ans    Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums souhaité : expériences indispensables : ·       Solide maîtrise de la programmation par contraintes, en particulier des algorithmes de filtrage des contraintes globales (cohérence d’arc généralisée) ·       Très bonne connaissance de l’algorithmique des graphes : parcours en profondeur, composantes fortement connexes, couplages et flots ·       Maîtrise avancée de Java et expérience du développement au sein raw.title: Ingénieur·e de recherche et développement en Programmation par Contraintes
raw.description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE

Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Au sein du Département Automatique, Productique et Informatique, le poste sera associé à l’équipe TASC (Théorie, Algorithmes et Systèmes en Contraintes ) dont les thématiques de recherche s’articulent autour de la programmation par contraintes, de la théorie aux applications en passant par l’hybridation. Dans ce cadre, le poste a pour objectif de venir en soutien au développement du solveur de contraintes choco-solver (http://choco-solver.org) maintenu par l’équipe TASC.

 

MISSIONS

Sous la responsabilité fonctionnelle du responsable du projet et développeur principal de la plateforme Choco-solver et en collaboration avec les membres de l’équipe TASC, les missions principales du poste sont :

  1.   Adapter l’algorithme bimodal aux contraintes reposant sur des parcours en profondeur, telles que GlobalCardinality, StableKeysort ou Circuit ;

  2.   Étudier la transposition des bénéfices de l’approche bimodale au cœur d’un solveur de contraintes (p. ex. le moteur de propagation) ;

  3.   Évaluer l’impact des explications paresseuses (lazy) dans les contraintes Sum et AllDifferent, entre autres ;

  4.   Participer à la rédaction d’articles scientifiques liés à ces sujets.

 

 ACTIVITÉS : Activité par mission

 

  1.      Adapter l’algorithme bimodal aux contraintes reposant sur des parcours en profondeur

·       Analyse les algorithmes de filtrage de GlobalCardinality, StableKeysort et Circuit disponibles dans choco-solver et identifie les parcours en profondeur (composantes fortement connexes, chemins alternants, etc.) susceptibles de bénéficier de l’approche bimodale

·       Conçoit et implémente en Java les variantes bimodales de ces algorithmes, en garantissant le niveau de cohérence attendu

·     Vérifie la correction des implémentations par des tests unitaires et des tests aléatoires comparant les résultats avec les propagateurs existants

·       Mesure les gains obtenus (temps de filtrage, passage à l’échelle) sur des jeux d’instances de référence (XCSP3, MiniZinc Challenge)

·       Intègre les développements validés dans la version publique de choco-solver (revue de code, documentation, intégration continue)

 

2.      Étudier la transposition des bénéfices de l’approche bimodale au cœur d’un solveur de contraintes

·       Étudie le fonctionnement interne de choco-solver (moteur de propagation, ordonnancement des propagateurs, gestion des événements) afin d’identifier les mécanismes pouvant tirer parti d’une stratégie bimodale

·       Propose et prototype une ou plusieurs adaptations, par exemple un basculement dynamique entre modes de propagation

·       Évalue expérimentalement ces prototypes et analyse les compromis entre coût et bénéfice

 

3.      Évaluer l’impact des explications paresseuses (

·       Implémente ou étend la génération paresseuse d’explications pour les contraintes Sum, AllDifferent et d’autres contraintes globales

·       Compare les explications paresseuses aux explications calculées pendant la propagation (taille des clauses apprises, temps de résolution, nombre de nœuds explorés)

·       Conçoit et conduit un protocole expérimental reproductible, puis analyse et synthétise les résultats

 

4.      Participer à la rédaction d’articles scientifiques liés à ces sujets.

·       Rédige en anglais des articles scientifiques présentant les contributions, en vue de soumissions à des conférences (CP, IJCAI, AAAI, CPAIOR) ou revues (Constraints) internationales

·       Prépare les artefacts expérimentaux associés (code, scripts, données) afin d’assurer la reproductibilité des résultats

·       Présente les travaux en séminaire d’équipe et, le cas échéant, en conférence

 


FORMATION ET COMPÉTENCES :

Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums requis :

·       Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalent

·       Diplôme Bac + 4 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 4 ans

·       Diplôme Bac + 3 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 6 ans

·       Diplôme Bac + 2 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 10 ans 

 

Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums souhaité :

·       Doctorat en informatique dans le domaine de la programmation par contraintes, ou thèse en cours dont la soutenance est prévue pendant la durée du contrat

 

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables :

·       Solide maîtrise de la programmation par contraintes, en particulier des algorithmes de filtrage des contraintes globales (cohérence d’arc généralisée)

·       Très bonne connaissance de l’algorithmique des graphes : parcours en profondeur, composantes fortement connexes, couplages et flots

·       Maîtrise avancée de Java et expérience du développement au sein de choco-solver (architecture interne, propagateurs, moteur de propagation)

·       Expérience de la conception et de la conduite d’évaluations expérimentales rigoureuses d’algorithmes

·       Expérience de la rédaction d’articles scientifiques en anglais

 

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

·       Publication(s) sur le filtrage de contraintes globales dans des conférences internationales du domaine (CP, IJCAI, AAAI, CPAIOR…)

·       Connaissances en génération paresseuse de clauses (LCG) et en résolution SAT de type CDCL

·       Pratique du développement logiciel libre et collaboratif (Git/GitHub, intégration continue, tests, micro-benchmarks avec JMH)

·       Connaissance des formats de modélisation XCSP3 et MiniZinc

 

Capacités et aptitudes :

·       Autonomie et capacité à mener un travail de recherche de bout en bout, de l’idée à la publication

·       Rigueur scientifique et méthodologique

·       Goût pour le travail en équipe et aisance dans la communication scientifique, à l’écrit comme à l’oral

·       Sens de l’organisation pour mener de front plusieurs pistes dans un calendrier resserré

2-    INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES

Faire vivre la marque et la communauté qui nourrissent le funnel L'acquisition ne marche pas sans contenu ni preuve sociale. C'est le carburant du tunnel. C'est ce qui te permet d'avancer vite et de tester dix fois plus d'hypothèses qu'une équipe classique. Le profil que nous recherchons 🌟 Formation : école de commerce ou de communication, en M1 ou M2, idéalement avec une spécialisation marketing, growth ou entrepreneuriat Pratique IA personnelle prouvée : tu as un side project, un compte ChatGPT ou Claude que tu utilises tous les jours, un workflow Make ou n8n que tu as construit, un agent custom, un blog assisté par LLM, un repo GitHub, ou n'importe quoi qui démontre que l'IA est dans ta vie. Réflexe growth : tu penses en funnel avant de penser en campagne, tu formules des hypothèses avant de produire, et tester puis mesurer te vient plus naturellement que produire pour produire Appétence data : Excel ou Google Sheets n'ont pas de secret pour toi, et l'idée de creuser un dashboard pour comprendre pourquoi un taux de conversion a bougé t'intéresse plus qu'elle ne t'ennuie Fibre communication : tu sais écrire pour être lu, tu as déjà animé une page, un compte ou une communauté Rigueur opérationnelle et sens du détail : tu sais qu'une séquence email qui commence par « Bonjour {prénom} », ça fait tâche, et qu'un A/B test mal cadré ne prouve rien Sensibilité business : tu comprends les concepts MQL, CAC, NPS, et tu sais qu'une belle campagne ne vaut rien si elle ne remplit pas les sessions Au-delà des hard skills, on recherche surtout quelqu’un de curieux, volontaire, débrouillard et qui n’a pas peur de proposer des nouvelles idées ! Fonctionnement quotidien en équipe avec les autres Head of (Content, Design) et le CMO Cadre de travail : bureaux 23 rue Taitbout (Paris 9), équipe marketing de 8 personnes Rémunération : grille légale alternance, transparente dès l'entretien Le process 🎢 Envoie ton CV, un lien vers un side project ou portfolio (même bricolé). Pas de lettre de motivation. As Alan’s Risk Expert, you will be in charge of providing Alan with automated and scalable risk assessment tools:

  • Risk modeling

    • You will be in charge of strengthening and automating the building our Solvency 2 balance sheet and capital requirements projections, covering both health, death and disability business lines

    • You will model new risks when they arise (new insurance products, branches, international, investment etc.)

    • You will support the board meetings preparation and communication with investors regarding capital evolution and market risks

    • You will scale and automate the production of our regulatory quantitative reporting and contribute to our narrative (SFCR, RSR) and ORSA reports

    • You will make proposals to improve our capital management in the 4 countries Alan is present

    • You will create processes and resources to strengthen the team’s ability to understand our risk and capital constraints

    • You will support the identification and hiring of new talents for the Insurance and Risk teams.

  • Have at last 8 years of experience in Solvency 2 regulatory framework, especially for S2 accounting, with knowledge of Health, Life and Market risks as a bonus

  • Are fluent in English and in French for regulatory interactions

  • Possess excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, including data analysis capabilities

  • Can automate processes and build new tools, with programming skills being a plus

  • Bring rigor and reliability to reporting production while working independently in a fast-paced environment

  • Have strong communication skills for effective interaction with internal and external stakeholders

  • Are confident learning new tools, technologies, and methodologies with creative problem-solving approaches
